safi-cedvel:13-14.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of oath (lām al-qasam) for an implied oath; (قد) particle of verification (taḥqīq); (أهلكنا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (القرون) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من قبل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أهلكنا), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لمّا ظلموا) like «لمّا كشفنا» «1»; (الواو) of ḥāl (circumstantial); (جاءت) past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (رسل) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (بالبيّنات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاءتهم); (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (كانوا) like the previous one «2»; (اللام) the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); (يؤمنوا) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يؤمنوا..) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كانوا».
(كذلك) like the previous one «3», and the governing word (ʿāmil) is the verb (نجزي), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «نحن», for majesty; (المجرمين) naʿt (adjective) of «القوم», accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; and (القوم) is mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «أهلكنا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, the response to an implied oath.
The clause «ظلموا» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: when they did wrong We destroyed them.
The clause «جاءتهم رسلهم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, with «قد» implied.
The clause «ما كانوا ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ظلموا».
The clause «يؤمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative «أن».
The clause «نجزي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive — or parenthetical.
(ثمّ) conjunction; (جعلنا) like «أهلكنا», and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (خلائف) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (في الأرض) preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt of «خلائف»; (من بعد) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جعلناكم), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) of purpose (taʿlīl); (ننظر) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām; (كيف) interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl, its governing word being (تعملون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.
And the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ننظر) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (جعلناكم).
The clause «جعلناكم..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the implied resumptive oath clause in the previous verse.
The clause «ننظر» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative «أن».
The clause «تعملون» is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb of «النظر», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) like the previous one [Note: in verse (12) of this sūra.], attached to (قال); (تتلى) imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (على) preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تتلى); (آيات) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بيّنات) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (قال) past verb; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (لا يرجون لقاءنا) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (7) of this sūra.]; (ائت) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; (بقرآن) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ائت); (غير) naʿt (adjective) of «قرآن», genitive (majrūr); (ها) particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) demonstrative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (أو) conjunction; (بدّل) like «ائت», and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (قل) like «ائت»; (ما) negating; (يكون) imperfect verb, complete (tāmm), nominative [Note: i.e. it is not fitting for me ...]; (اللام) preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يكون); (أن) maṣdar particle; (أبدّل) imperfect verb, accusative, and the fāʿil is «أنا», and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من تلقاء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أبدّله); (نفس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) particle of negation; (أتّبع) like «أبدّل», but it is nominative; (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يوحى) imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); (اليّ) like «لي», attached to (يوحى).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن أبدّله) is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil of «يكون».
(إنّ) particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of «إنّ»; (أخاف) like «أبدّل», but it is nominative; (إن) jussive conditional particle; (عصيت) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (التاء) is a pronoun, fāʿil; (ربّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is like it in «نفسي»; (عذاب) mafʿūl bihi, its governing word being «أخاف», accusative; (يوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (عظيم) naʿt of «يوم», genitive.
The clause «تتلى ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال الذين ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا يرجون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ائت ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «بدّله» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ائت».
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ما يكون ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أبدّله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause إن أتّبع ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يوحى إليّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «إنّي أخاف ...» has no grammatical position, being another statement of cause.
The clause «أخاف ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
The clause «إن عصيت ...» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: then I fear the punishment of Allah.

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) like the previous one [Note: in the previous verse (15).]; (لو) non-jussive conditional particle; (شاء) past verb; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (ما) negating; (تلوت) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.. and (التاء) is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عليكم) like «عليهم» [Note: see verse (21) of Sūrat al-Anʿām and verse (37) of Sūrat al-Aʿrāf.]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (أدرى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», i.e. Allah; (الباء) preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أدرى); (الفاء) causal (taʿlīliyya); (قد) particle of verification (taḥqīq); (لبثت) like «تلوت»; (في) preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (لبثت); (عمرا) mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (لبثت), and it is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. «مدة عمر» or «أمد عمر» (the span of a lifetime); (من قبل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (لبثت), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الهمزة) for the interrogative of rebuke (istifhām tawbīkhī); (لا) negating; (تعقلون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لو شاء اللَّه ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ما تلوته ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا أدراكم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the apodosis clause.
The clause «لبثت ...» has no grammatical position, being causal.
The clause «تعقلون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an omitted resumptive clause, i.e. «أغاب عنكم ذلك فلا تعقلون» (has that been hidden from you, so that you do not reason?).

* Morphology:
(أدرى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is «أدري» — with yāʾ — the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa and was changed into alif; its pattern is أفعل. (عمرا): the noun from «عمر يعمر», of the pattern-class ضرب, and of the pattern-class نصر, meaning life or what is long of it; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas.

safi-cedvel:17-17.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (من) interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أظلم) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (من) preposition; (من) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أظلم»; (افترى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو», and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); (على اللَّه) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى); (كذبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its synonym.]; (أو) conjunction; (كذّب) past verb, and the fāʿil is «هو»; (بآيات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّب), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إنّ) particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الهاء) is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), in the position of the accusative as the noun of «إنّ»; (لا) negating; (يفلح) imperfect verb, nominative; (المجرمون) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «من أظلم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «افترى ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «كذّب ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause.
The clause «إنّه لا يفلح المجرمون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا يفلح المجرمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «إنّ».

* Rhetoric:
The interrogative departing from its original meaning: in His saying, the Exalted, «فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِباً» there is a rhetorical interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī) meaning negation, i.e. no one is more unjust than that; and the negation of being "more unjust", as is well known, is a metonymy (kināya) for the negation of equality. What is meant is that he is more unjust than any wrongdoer.

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يعبدون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من دون) preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of «يعبدون», i.e. bypassing Allah; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ما) relative noun [Note: or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa).. and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective).], indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لا يضرّ) like «لا يفلح» [Note: in the previous verse (17).], and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is «هو», and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); (الواو) conjunction; (ينفعهم) like «يضرّهم»; (الواو) conjunction; (يقولون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ها) particle of alerting (tanbīh); (أولاء) demonstrative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (شفعاء) khabar (predicate), nominative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (عند) adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شفعاء»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; (الهمزة) for the interrogative of denial and wonder (istifhām inkārī taʿajjubī); (تنبّئون) like «يعبدون»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; (الباء) preposition; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive [Note: or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.. and the clause after it is a naʿt.], attached to (تنبّئون); (لا يعلم) like «لا يضرّ»; (في السموات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعلم); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation; (في الأرض) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what the first prepositional phrase is attached to, because it is conjoined to it; (سبحان) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (تعالى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil is «هو»; (عن) preposition; (ما) maṣdar particle; (يشركون) like «يعبدون».
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (ما يشركون) is in the position of the genitive, attached to (تعالى).
The clause «يعبدون ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا يضرّهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا ينفعهم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يعبدون».
The clause «هؤلاء شفعاؤنا» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أتنبّئون الله» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «لا يعلم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause « (نسبّح) سبحانه» has no grammatical position, being a parenthetical clause of supplication (duʿāʾiyya).
The clause «تعالى» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the parenthetical one.
The clause «يشركون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction — or resumptive —; (ما) negating; (كان) past verb, incomplete (nāqiṣ) — abrogating (nāsikh) —; (الناس) the noun of «كان», nominative (marfūʿ); (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أمّة) khabar (predicate) of «كان», accusative (manṣūb); (واحدة) naʿt (adjective) of «أمّة», accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (اختلفوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunction; (لولا) non-jussive conditional particle; (كلمة) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being «موجودة» (existent); (سبقت) past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is «هي»; (من ربّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt of «كلمة», and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (اللام) occurring in the response of «لولا»; (قضي) past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», i.e. the punishment understood from the context of the speech; (بين) adverb, accusative, attached to (قضي); (في) preposition; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (قضي); (في) like the first one, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يختلفون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ما كان الناس ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.. or conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يعبدون»..
The clause «اختلفوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «لولا كلمة ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «سبقت» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of «كلمة».
The clause «قضي بينهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يختلفون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:20-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (يقولون) like «يختلفون» [Note: in the previous verse.]; (لولا) particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), meaning «هلّا»; (أنزل) past verb, passive; (على) preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل); (آية) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (من ربّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل) [Note: or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «آية».], and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) linking (rābiṭa) for the apodosis of an implied condition; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (إنّما) restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (الغيب) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (لله) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (الفاء) linking for the apodosis of another implied condition; (انتظروا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إنّ) particle resembling the verb — abrogating (nāsikh) —, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of «إنّ»; (مع) adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to «المنتظرين» [Note: or attached to the khabar of «إنّ».], and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من المنتظرين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of «إنّ», the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «يقولون ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يعبدون» [Note: in verse (18) of this sūra.].
The clause «لولا أنزل.. آية» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قل ...» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. if they say this saying, then say..
The clause «الغيب لله» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «انتظروا....» is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if you do not believe, then wait..
The clause «إنّي.. من المنتظرين» has no grammatical position, having the status of a statement of cause (taʿlīl).

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis; (أذقنا) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn.. and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent); (الناس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (رحمة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من بعد) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أذقنا); (ضرّاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote, since it ends in the extended alif of the feminine; (مسّ) past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (إذا) particle of surprise (fujāʾiyya); (اللام) preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (مكر) delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (في آيات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «مكر», with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. «في تأويل آياتنا» (in the interpretation of Our signs), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أسرع) khabar, nominative; (مكرا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (إنّ) like the previous one [Note: in verse (20) of this sūra.
(2, 3) in verse (19) of this sūra.]; (رسل) the noun of «إنّ», accusative, and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi; (يكتبون) like «يختلفون» «2»; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (تمكرون) like «يختلفون» «3».
The clause «أذقنا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «مسّتهم» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt (adjective) of «ضرّاء».
The clause «لهم مكر ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله أسرع ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّ رسلنا يكتبون..» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يكتبون ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «إنّ».
The clause «تمكرون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما), and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted.

* Rhetoric:
Allusion (al-ishāra): in His saying «قُلِ اللَّهُ أَسْرَعُ مَكْراً» there is the device of allusion, because the elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) indicated that their scheming was swift, but Allah's scheming is swifter than it. And speed is understood from the «إذا» of surprise. The meaning is that they rushed into scheming suddenly, i.e. they carried it out by way of suddenness and speed.

safi-cedvel:22-23.t:
* I'rab:
(هو) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (يسيّر) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (في البرّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسيّر); (الواو) conjunction; (البحر) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «البرّ», genitive (majrūr); (حتّى) particle of beginning (ibtidāʾ); (إذا) like the previous one [Note: in the previous verse.], attached to (جاءتها); (كنتم) past verb, incomplete (nāqiṣ) — abrogating (nāsikh) —, indeclinable on sukūn.. and (تم) is the noun of «كان»; (في الفلك) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of «كنتم»; (الواو) conjunction; (جرين) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn.. and (النون) is the nūn of the feminine plural, i.e. the ships; (الباء) preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (جرين), and in it there is a shift (iltifāt) from address to the third person; (بريح) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جرين) [Note: the bāʾ in (بهم) is for transitivity (taʿdiya), and the bāʾ in (بريح) is causal (sababiyya), and therefore it is permissible to attach both to a single governing word.. And it is permissible for the second bāʾ to be of accompaniment (mulābasa), so that the preposition and its genitive noun are a ḥāl (circumstantial).]; (طيّبة) naʿt (adjective) of «ريح», genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (فرحوا) past verb with its fāʿil; (بها) like «بهم», attached to (فرحوا); (جاءت) past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (ريح) fāʿil, nominative; (عاصف) naʿt of «ريح», nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (جاءهم الموج) like «جاءتها ريح»; (من كلّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاء); (مكان) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (ظنّوا) like «فرحوا»; (أنّ) particle resembling the verb — abrogating —, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of «أنّ»; (أحيط) past verb, passive; (بهم) like the first one, in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e. as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive verb.]; (دعوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two sukūns.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (مخلصين) ḥāl, accusative, of the fāʿil of «دعوا», the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (اللام) preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to «مخلصين»; الدين) mafʿūl bihi of the active participle «مخلصين», accusative; (اللام) paving for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) jussive conditional particle; (أنجيت) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (التاء) is the fāʿil, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من) preposition; (ها) particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذه) demonstrative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (أنجيتنا); اللام) the lām of oath (lām al-qasam); (نكونن) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the noun of «نكون» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «نحن»; (من الشاكرين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of «نكوننّ», the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أنّهم أحيط.) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «ظنّوا».
The clause «هو الذي ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يسيّركم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «كنتم ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «جرين ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «كنتم».
The clause «فرحوا ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «كنتم» [Note: or a ḥāl of the pronoun of (بهم), with «قد» implied.].
The clause «جاءتها ريح ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «جاءهم الموج ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «ظنّوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «أحيط بهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «أنّ».
The clause «دعوا ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: or a badal (substitute) of the clause «ظنّوا», a substitute of inclusion (badal ishtimāl).].
The clause «إن أنجيتنا» has no grammatical position, being an explanation of the meaning of the verb «دعوا» [Note: because «دعوا» means «قالوا» (they said).. And it is permissible for the clause to be the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying, i.e. «قائلين: لئن ...» (saying: if ...).].
The clause «نكوننّ ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
(الفاء) conjunction; (لمّا) adverb meaning «حين» (when), containing the meaning of condition, attached to the content of the apodosis; (أنجى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is «هو»; (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya); (هم) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يبغون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في الأرض) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يبغون); (بغير) preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يبغون», i.e. avoiding the truth; (الحقّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (يا) vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is a particle of alerting; (الناس) badal of «أيّ» — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) —, following it in the nominative in form; (إنّما بغيكم على أنفسكم) like «إنّما الغيب لله», and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi in both words; (متاع) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb [Note: or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl.. And it is an adverb (ẓarf) according to Abū Ḥayyān, and the governing word of the ḥāl and the adverb is the notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār) in the khabar, not the maṣdar «بغيكم».. And some parsed it as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), on the basis that the prepositional phrase (على أنفسكم) is attached to the maṣdar «بغيكم», i.e.: your transgression against yourselves for the sake of the enjoyment of this world is blameworthy.]; (الحياة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الدنيا) naʿt of «الحياة», genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif; (ثمّ) conjunction; (إلى) preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (مرجع) delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative.. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (ننبّئ) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is «نحن», for majesty, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بما كنتم تعملون) like «بما كانوا يكفرون» [Note: in verse (4) of this sūra.].
The clause «أنجاهم ...» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of (لمّا) to it.
The clause «هم يبغون» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يبغون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هم».
The clause «يأيّها الناس ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إنّما بغيكم على أنفسكم» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause (تتمتّعون) متاع..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: or a ḥāl of the pronoun of the one addressed.].
The clause «إلينا مرجعكم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the last resumptive clause.
The clause «ننبئكم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «إلينا مرجعكم».
The clause «كنتم تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما), whether nominal or particle.
The clause «تعملون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of «كنتم».

* Morphology:
(عاصف): active participle of «عصف يعصف», of the pattern-class ضرب; it is an adjective applied to the masculine and the feminine, and «عاصفة» is also said; its pattern is فاعل.
(الموج): a noun on the pattern of the maṣdar, for the water that rises on its surface; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its singular is «موجة», its plural «أمواج».
(يبغون): see verse (83) of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān.. the morphology is the same but the meaning is different.

* Rhetoric:
1- Shift (al-iltifāt): in His saying, the Exalted: «حَتَّى إِذا كُنْتُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَرَيْنَ بِهِمْ بِرِيحٍ طَيِّبَةٍ» there is a shift from address to the third person, to signal the bad state they are in, which necessitates turning away from them, as though He were recounting the evils of their states to others.
2- Dependent metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tabaʿiyya): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُمْ أُحِيطَ بِهِمْ», i.e. they were destroyed; so in the speech there is a dependent metaphor. And it has been said: the encompassing is a metaphor for the blocking of the paths of escape, likening it to an enemy encompassing a person; then by that metaphor He alluded (kanā) to destruction, since it is among its consequences and concomitants.
3- Loose metonymy (al-majāz al-mursal): in His saying, the Exalted, «إِنَّما بَغْيُكُمْ عَلى أَنْفُسِكُمْ», its meaning is: your transgression is only a calamity (wabāl) upon yourselves, because transgression does not fall upon the selves; rather it is the calamity that does. And since transgression is its cause, He mentioned it by way of majāz mursal, the relationship being causality.

* Benefits:
The things by which an intransitive verb becomes transitive.
In this verse comes His saying, the Exalted, هُوَ الَّذِي يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ, and it is noticeable that the verb «يسيّر» has become transitive to a direct object, while the original verb (سار) is intransitive; when it became «سيّر» on the pattern فعّل it became transitive. To complete the benefit we will mention the cases in which an intransitive verb becomes transitive, and they are:
1- The entry of the hamza of transitivity at its beginning, as in His saying, the Exalted: أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّباتِكُمْ and رَبَّنا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ.
A verb transitive to one object may be transferred by the hamza to being transitive to two: as in «ألبست زيدا ثوبا» (I clothed Zayd in a garment); and a verb transitive to two has not been transferred to three by the hamza except in «رأى» and «علم», as in: «أعلم الجندي القائد الأمر خطيرا» (the soldier informed the commander that the matter was grave).
2- The alif of mutuality (mufāʿala): for «جلس زيد» and «مشى» and «سار» you say «جالست زيدا» (I sat with Zayd), «ماشيته» (I walked with him), «سايرته» (I travelled with him).
3- Forming it on the pattern «فعلت» to convey overcoming (ghalaba): you say «كرمت زيدا», i.e. I surpassed him in generosity.
4- Forming it on the pattern استفعل for seeking or for attributing something, as in «استخرجت المال» and «واستحسنت زيدا», i.e. I sought the extraction of the money, and I attributed goodness to Zayd.
5- Doubling the middle radical (ʿayn): for «فرح زيد» you say «فرّحته» (I made him glad), and of this is His saying, the Exalted, that comes in this verse: «هُوَ الَّذِي يُسَيِّرُكُمْ».

safi-cedvel:58-58.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت). (بفضل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb indicated by what is mentioned after it, i.e. "rejoicing is fitting at the coming of Allah's bounty" [Note: There is an omitted muḍāf in the speech, as is evident.. Or it is attached to the verb "an admonition has come to you" implied after قل.], (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (برحمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what (بفضل) is attached to, so it is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), for linking with what precedes. (الباء) a preposition. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) of (فضل الله) with the preposition repeated.. and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) is for address. (الفاء) is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, conveying the meaning of causation [Note: It is clear that when the fāʾ conveys the meaning of causation it departs from pure conjunction; for this reason it is valid to conjoin a declarative to an injunctive (inshāʾ) with it, and vice versa.], (اللام) the lām of command. (يفرحوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: The pronoun that is the mubtadaʾ refers back to the rejoicing understood from the context of the verse.], (من) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to خير [Note: The referent pronoun is omitted.. Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by (من), and there is no referent pronoun.], (يجمعون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «(يحسن الفرح) بفضل الله» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «يفرحوا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl [Note: There is an omitted muḍāf in the speech, as is evident.. Or it is attached to the verb "an admonition has come to you" implied after قل.] [Translator's note: this footnote repeats verbatim the first footnote of the entry, as in the source.]: or it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if bounty and mercy from Allah have come to them, then let them rejoice".. or "if they rejoice at anything, then let them rejoice because of Allah's bounty" ...
The clause «هو خير ...» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يجمعون» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).

safi-cedvel:59-59.t:
* I'rab:
(قل أرأيتم) their i'rab has preceded [Note: In verse (50) of this sūra.], i.e. "inform me".. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: Some parsed it as an interrogative noun, mafʿūl bihi of the verb أنزل, or as mubtadaʾ on the assumption that the object is omitted, i.e. أنزله, and the clause stands in place of the two objects of أرأيتم.] (أنزل) a past verb. (الله) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل), (من رزق) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted referent pronoun. (الفاء) conjunction. (جعلتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (جعلتم) [Note: Or attached to an omitted second object of (جعل).], and (من) is partitive. (حراما) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (حلالا) conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the wāw to (حراما), accusative. (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you". (الهمزة) for interrogation. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (أذن) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (لكم) like the first, attached to (أذن), (أم) is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one meaning بل, for transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī). (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تفترون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أرأيتم ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «أنزل الله ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «جعلتم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «قل» has no grammatical position; resumptive, emphasizing the first.
The clause «الله أذن ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl [Note: The second object of the verb أرأيتم is omitted, indicated by the speech mentioned after it; the implied form is: "Have you considered what Allah has sent down for you ... as to your ordering of this prohibition and permission?"].
The clause «أذن لكم..» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «تفترون» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(حراما), maṣdar (verbal noun) of حرم يحرم, of the class of فرح and the class of كرم, used as an adjective for intensiveness; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
Majāz (figurative usage): in His saying, Exalted is He, «قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ», the use of أنزل for what is mentioned is majāz by applying the effect to the cause; and it has been permitted that the attribution be figurative (isnād majāzī), in that the sending down is attributed to the provision because it is its cause, like rain that is sent down.

safi-cedvel:60-60.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (ظنّ) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (يفترون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفترون), (الكذب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) [Note: Or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).. see verse (50) of Sūrat al-Nisāʾ.], (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to ظنّ. (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative. (اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis. (ذو) khabar of inna, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (فضل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (على الناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فضل. (الواو) conjunction. (لكنّ) like إنّ, for rectification (istidrāk). (أكثر) the noun of lākinna, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (لا) negative. (يشكرون) like يفترون.
The clause «ما ظنّ ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يفترون ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الله لذو ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لكنّ أكثرهم لا يشكرون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the last resumptive clause.
The clause «لا يشكرون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of lākinna.

safi-cedvel:61-61.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative in the three places. (تكون) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb [Note: Or complete (tāmm), and the fāʿil (agent) is "you", and (في شأن) is attached to it.], nominative (marfūʿ), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you" (أنت). (في شأن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). (الواو) conjunction. (تتلو) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw, and the fāʿil is "you". (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تتلو), and the pronoun refers to Allah, and من is for beginning (ibtidāʾiyya) [Note: It is permissible for the pronoun to refer to the matter (الشأن), with (من) causal.. i.e. you recite a Qur'an because of the matter that befell you.], (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (قرآن) genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (كنّا) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (نا) is its noun. (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (شهودا), which is the khabar of كنّا, accusative. (إذ) an adverb for past time, attached to (شهودا), (تفيضون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (فيه) like منه, attached to (تفيضون), (الواو) conjunction. (يعزب) a negated imperfect verb, nominative. (عن ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعزب), and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (من) a redundant preposition. (مثقال) genitive in form, nominative in position, fāʿil of يعزب. (ذرّة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (مثقال ذرّة), (الواو) conjunction. (لا) redundant, for emphasizing the negation. (في السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what (في الأرض) is attached to, so it is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) redundant, for emphasizing the negation [Note: According to al-Zamakhsharī it is the lā of generic negation, its noun being أصغر and its khabar في كتاب, and (إلّا) is then a particle of restriction; this is a good interpretation because of the existence of a reading of (أصغر) in the nominative as a mubtadaʾ.] (أصغر) conjoined to مثقال ذرّة in form, genitive like it, and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa because it is a diptote, due to being an adjective and on the pattern أفعل. (من) a preposition. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to أصغر.. and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (الواو) conjunction. (لا أكبر) like لا أصغر. (إلّا) meaning لكن, for the disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ). (في كتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو", i.e. all things. (مبين) naʿt of كتاب, genitive.
The clause «ما تكون في شأن..» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ما تتلو ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لا تعملون ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كنّا عليكم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «تفيضون ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ما يعزب.. من مثقال ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «(هو) في كتاب ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(شأن), an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb شأنت أشأن, of the class of فتح, and it has the meaning of the passive participle; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(شهودا), plural of شاهد or شهيد; the first is an active participle and the second a ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle).
(أصغر), an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral صغر; its pattern is أفعل.
(أكبر), an elative noun from the triliteral كبر; its pattern is أفعل; and see verse (217) of Sūrat al-Baqara.

* Rhetoric:
- In His saying, Glorified and Exalted is He, «وَما يَعْزُبُ عَنْ رَبِّكَ مِنْ مِثْقالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلا فِي السَّماءِ», the earth is put before the heaven, unlike His saying in Sūrat Sabaʾ «عالِمِ الْغَيْبِ لا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّماواتِ وَلا فِي الْأَرْضِ», and the right of the heaven is to be put before the earth; but since He mentioned His witnessing of the affairs of the people of the earth, their states and their deeds, and joined to that His saying «لا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ», putting the earth before the heaven suited that.

safi-cedvel:24-24.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما مثل الحياة الدنيا كماء) like «إنّما الغيب لله» [Note: in verse (4) of this sūra.] [Translator's note: so in the source; «إنّما الغيب لله» is in verse (20) of this sūra.]; (الحياة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الدنيا) naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة», genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (أنزلنا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn. and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من السماء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزلناه); (الفاء) conjunction; (اختلط) past verb; (الباء) preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (اختلط); (نبات) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الأرض) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من) preposition; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نبات الأرض»; (يأكل) imperfect verb, nominative; (الناس) fāʿil, nominative; (الأنعام) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الناس» by the wāw, nominative. (حتّى إذا) their i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (22) of this sūra.]; (أخذت) past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (الأرض) fāʿil, nominative; (زخرف) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ازيّنت) like «أخذت», and the fāʿil is «هي»; (الواو) conjunction; (ظنّ) past verb; (أهل) fāʿil, nominative, and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أنّ) particle resembling the verb — abrogating (nāsikh) —, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of «أنّ»; (قادرون) khabar (predicate) of «أنّ», nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (على) preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the khabar; (أتاها) like «أنجاهم» [Note: in verse (23) of this sūra.]; (أمر) fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ليلا) adverb of time, accusative, attached to (أتى); (أو) conjunction; (نهارا) conjoined to (ليلا), accusative, and attached to what the word it is conjoined to is attached to; (الفاء) conjunction; (جعلنا) like «أنزلنا», and (ها) is a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (حصيدا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (كأن) lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is an omitted pronoun; (لم) particle of negation and jussive; (تغن) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is «هي»; (بالأمس) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تغن); (الكاف) preposition [Note: or a noun meaning «مثل», in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its description.]; (ذلك) demonstrative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governing word is «نفصّل».. and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (نفصّل) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is «نحن», for majesty; (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (لقوم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نفصّل); (يتفكّرون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «مثل الحياة.. كماء» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنزلناه» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt of «ماء».
The clause «اختلط به نبات ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «أنزلناه».
The clause «يأكل الناس» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «أخذت الأرض ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ازيّنت ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause أخذت؟
الأرض.
The clause «أتاها أمرنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «جعلناها ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «كأن لم تغن ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the object of «جعلناها».
The clause «لم تغن ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «كأن».
The clause «نفصّل الآيات» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يتفكّرون» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt of «قوم».

* Morphology:
(ازّيّنت): in it the tāʾ is substituted by zāy; its origin is «تزيّنت»; the tāʾ was changed into zāy, then given sukūn for assimilation (idghām), then the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) was brought to avoid beginning with a sukūn; its pattern is اتفعّلت.
(حصيدا): a derived adjective from «حصد يحصد», of the pattern-class نصر; its pattern is فعيل in the sense of مفعول, i.e. «محصودا», meaning like something harvested.
(تغن): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive, so there is a deleted alif in it; its pattern is تفع with fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(الأمس): an adverbial noun indicating the distant past; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.. its plural is «آمس» with ḍamma on the mīm, «أموس» with ḍamma on the hamza and the mīm, and «آماس»..
And the relative adjective (nisba) from it is «إمسيّ», with kasra on the hamza and sukūn on the mīm, irregularly.

* Rhetoric:
1- The compound simile (al-tashbīh al-murakkab): in the noble verse, in His saying, the Exalted, «إِنَّما مَثَلُ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا كَماءٍ أَنْزَلْناهُ مِنَ السَّماءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَباتُ الْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ النَّاسُ وَالْأَنْعامُ», the verse likens the state of this world, in the speed of its passing and the ending of its bliss after its approach, to the state of the plants of the earth in their drying up and turning into debris after they had become intertwined and dense and adorned the earth with their greenness and their glitter.
2- Metaphor by allusion (al-istiʿāra bi-l-kināya): in His saying, the Exalted, «حَتَّى إِذا أَخَذَتِ الْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَها وَازَّيَّنَتْ», in the speech there is a metaphor by allusion, since the earth is likened to a bride; the thing it is likened to is omitted, and the thing likened is put in its place. Ascribing to it the taking of adornment is a figurative image (takhyīl), and what follows is an elaboration (tarshīḥ).
3- Metaphor (al-istiʿāra): in His saying, the Exalted, «فَجَعَلْناها حَصِيداً» there is an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra muṣarraḥa). The original is «جعلنا نباتها هالكا» (We made its plants perish). So what perishes is likened to what is harvested, and the name of the thing it is likened to is put in its place. Supposing an omitted muḍāf does not contradict this, as has been imagined, because He did not liken the crops to what is harvested, but rather what perishes to it.
Al-Sakkākī held that in the speech there is a metaphor by allusion, since the adorned and embellished earth is likened to fresh, pleasing plants upon which has come what increases and enriches them, and «الحصيد» is made a figurative image (takhyīl).

* Benefits:
- Harmony in meaning:
This noble verse has expressed the speed of the passing away of the life of this world and its perishing, and that it is a deceptive adornment whose glitter quickly fades and goes out. There are touches in the expression that strongly suggest this meaning, for He, the Exalted, said إِنَّما مَثَلُ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا كَماءٍ أَنْزَلْناهُ مِنَ السَّماءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَباتُ الْأَرْضِ. Here we are in an expression of the speed of the passing of this world, and therefore the meaning came in harmony with this idea. We see how it is the plants that hasten to receive the water of the sky, although it is the water of the sky that falls upon the plants; in this there is a strength in the meaning that gives it a deep dimension. Likewise time leaps through rapid stages: how quickly the earth takes its adornment and is embellished, how quickly its people think that they are settled in its bliss, and how quickly the command of Allah comes to it by night or by day, so that it becomes a harvested field, as though it had not flourished the day before — a wonderful harmony and fit between meaning and structure that reaches the summit of perfection!

safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (يدعو) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw, and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (إلى دار) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يدعو); (السلام) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (يهدي) like «يدعو»; (من) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يشاء) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is «هو», i.e. Allah, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. «من يشاء اللَّه هدايته» (whose guidance Allah wills); (إلى صراط) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يهدي); (مستقيم) naʿt (adjective) of «صراط», genitive.
The clause «اللَّه يدعو ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يدعو ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يهدي ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يدعو».
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).

safi-cedvel:26-27.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) preposition; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (أحسنوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الحسنى) delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (زيادة) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الحسنى», nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (يرهق) imperfect verb, nominative; (وجوه) fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قتر) fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation; (ذلّة) conjoined to «قتر», nominative like it; (أولئك) demonstrative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) is a particle of address; (أصحاب) khabar, nominative; (الجنّة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (هم) detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (في) preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خالدون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «للذين أحسنوا الحسنى» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أحسنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا يرهق.. قتر» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one [Note: it is permissible for the wāw to be of ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause a khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هم», and the nominal clause is a ḥāl whose governing word is the notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.].
The clause «أولئك أصحاب ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is in the position of the nominative as second khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أولئك» [Note: or it has no grammatical position, being resumptive.].
(الواو) conjunction; (الذين) mubtadaʾ, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative [Note: or in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the preceding relative (للذين).. or «جزاء» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the relative that precedes it, with the preposition dropped, i.e. «وللذين كسبوا.. جزاء سيّئة», so that the division is balanced, and the conjunction becomes a conjunction of clauses.]; (كسبوا) like «أحسنوا»; (السيّئات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (جزاء) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (سيئة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (بمثل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of «جزاء», i.e. «مستقرّ» (settled), or «مقدّر» (decreed) [Note: it is permissible for the prepositional phrase to be attached to «جزاء», and the khabar then is omitted, its implied form being «واقع» (occurring) or «لهم» (theirs).. And Ibn Kaysān said that the bāʾ is redundant, i.e. «جزاء سيّئة مثلها», as comes in the verse: وجزاء سيّئة سيّئة مثلها.], and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ترهق) like «يرهق», and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (ذلّة) fāʿil, nominative; (ما) negating; (اللام) preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a fronted khabar; (من الله) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «عاصم»; (من) redundant preposition; (عاصم) genitive in form, nominative in position, a delayed mubtadaʾ; (كأنّما) restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (أغشيت) past verb, passive.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (وجوه) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قطعا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, by the verb «أغشيت» being made to include the meaning of «ألبست» (clothed); (من الليل) preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of (قطعا); (مظلما), ḥāl of «الليل», accusative [Note: and the governing word of the ḥāl is the notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār) to which (من الليل) is attached, i.e. pieces settled and existing from the night in the state of its darkness.]; (أولئك.... خالدون) like the first.
The clause «الذين كسبوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «للذين أحسنوا الحسنى».
The clause «كسبوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «جزاء سيّئة ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «ترهقهم ذلّة» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause «جزاء سيّئة» [Note: it is permissible for the wāw to be of ḥāl, and the clause a khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هم», and the nominal clause is a ḥāl.]..
The clause ما لهم.. من عاصم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: it is permissible for the clause to be the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).. and the two clauses between the mubtadaʾ and the khabar are parenthetical.].
The clause «كأنّما أغشيت وجوههم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: it is permissible for the clause to be the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين), and the three clauses between the mubtadaʾ and the khabar parenthetical; this is a rejected possibility.].
The clause «أولئك أصحاب ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is in the position of the nominative as second khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أولئك» [Note: it is permissible for the clause to be the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين), and the four clauses between the mubtadaʾ and the khabar parenthetical; this too is a rejected possibility.].

* Morphology:
(قتر): a noun meaning dust that has blackness in it, or it is smoke, and from it is the soot of the cooking pot; the colour may be meant rather than the substance; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas, and it is taken from the verb «قتر يقتر», of the pattern-classes نصر, ضرب and فرح.
(عاصم): active participle of the triliteral «عصم», of the pattern-class ضرب; its pattern is فاعل.
(قطعا): plural of «قطعة», a noun for what is cut off from a thing; its pattern is فعلة with kasra then sukūn, and the pattern of «قطع» is فعل with kasra then fatḥa.
(مظلما): active participle of the quadriliteral «أظلم»; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:107-107.t:
* [Note: See verse (17) of Sūrat al-Anʿām.]
I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive (majzūm); (يمسس) an imperfect verb, jussive, as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (بضرّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يمسس); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (كاشف) the noun of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate) of lā; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, badal (substitute) from the pronoun latent in the khabar — or from the position of lā and its noun —; (الواو) conjunction; (إن يردك بخير فلا رادّ لفضله) like «إن يمسسك.. كاشف له», and the final hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (يصيب) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he"; (به) like «له», attached to (يصيب); (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, mafʿūl bihi; (يشاء) like «يصيب».. and the mafʿūl is omitted, i.e., "his being struck by it" or "His harming him"; (من عباد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an [omitted] ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted resumptive pronoun, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (الغفور) khabar, nominative; (الرحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «يمسسك الله» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا كاشف له ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يردك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «يمسسك الله».
The clause «لا رادّ ...» is in the position of the jussive as the second apodosis.
The clause «يصيب به ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «هو الغفور ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «يصيب».

* Morphology:
(رادّ): active participle of the triliteral ردّ; its pattern is فاعل, and the ʿayn was assimilated (idghām) into the lām, so its ʿayn came to be vowelless.

safi-cedvel:108-109.t:
* I'rab:
(قل يأيّها الناس): its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (104) of this sūra.]; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (جاء) a past verb and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الحقّ) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاءكم) [Note: or attached to an [omitted] ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الحقّ».], and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) conjunction; (من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (اهتدى) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and the fāʿil is "he"; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّما) the restraining mā with what it restrains (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يهتدي) an imperfect verb, nominative, its sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif [Translator's note: so in the source; the word ends in yāʾ], and the fāʿil is "he"; (لنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يهتدي), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (من ضلّ ... يضل) like its counterpart; (على) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يضلّ), by its being made to include the sense of "draws the evil consequence upon it"; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) a negating Ḥijāzī mā, operating as laysa operates; (أنا) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, the noun of mā; (عليكم) like «عليها», attached to «وكيل»; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition and (وكيل) genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يأيّها الناس» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قد جاءكم الحقّ ...» has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.
The clause «من اهتدى ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative.
The clause «اهتدى ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «1».
The clause «إنّما يهتدي ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
The clause «من ضلّ ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «من اهتدى».
The clause «ضلّ ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «2».
The clause «إنّما يضلّ عليها» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ما أنا.. بوكيل» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative.
(الواو) conjunction; (اتّبع) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, mafʿūl bihi; (يوحى) a passive imperfect verb, nominative, its sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the resumptive pronoun; (إلى) a preposition and (الكاف) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يوحى); (الواو) conjunction; (اصبر) like «اتّبع»; (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (يحكم) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after «حتّى»; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (هو خير) like «هو الغفور» [Note: in verse (107) of this sūra.]; (الحاكمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, its sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحكم..) is in the position of the genitive by (حتّى), attached to (اصبر).
The clause «اتّبع ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «قل».
The clause «يوحى إليك ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «اصبر ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «اتّبع».
[The clause:] «يحكم اللَّه» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «هو خير ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: or it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty.].

* Morphology:
(الحاكمين): plural of «الحاكم», active participle of the triliteral حكم; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:62-64.t:
* I'rab:
(ألا) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — abrogating (nāsikh). (أولياء) the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb). (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (لا) negative, inoperative (muhmala) [Note: It may be operative, functioning like laysa, with (خوف) the noun of lā and (عليهم) its khabar.], (خوف) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: It came indefinite because it leans on a negation.], (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) redundant (zāʾida), for emphasizing the negation. (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. (يحزنون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «إنّ أولياء الله ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا خوف عليهم» is in the position of nominative as khabar of inna.
The clause «لا هم يحزنون» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the khabar clause.
The clause «يحزنون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of أولياء [Note: Or khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هم.. or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the coming clause لهم البشرى..
or a second khabar of (إنّ).], (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الواو) conjunction. (كانوا) an incomplete past verb — abrogating — and the wāw is the noun of kāna. (يتّقون) like يحزنون.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يتّقون» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كانوا.
(اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar. (البشرى) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (في الحياة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to البشرى [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from البشرى, the governing word being the "being settled" (al-istiqrār) to which (لهم) is attached.], (الدنيا) naʿt of الحياة, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied on the alif. (الواو) conjunction. (في الآخرة) like في الحياة in i'rab and attachment, so it is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it. (لا) the lā of generic negation. (تبديل) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative. (لكلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar of lā. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ..
and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (هو) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: Or a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الفوز, and the nominal clause is the khabar of ذلك.], (الفوز) khabar of the demonstrative, nominative. (العظيم) naʿt of الفوز, nominative.
The clause «لهم البشرى» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لا تبديل لكلمات ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ذلك هو الفوز ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تبديل), a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb بدّل; its pattern is تفعيل.

* Benefits:
- The concept of the walī (friend of Allah):
The scholars differed over who deserves this name. Ibn ʿAbbās said:
They are those at the sight of whom Allah is remembered.
Al-Ṭabarī narrated with his chain from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, in mursal form, that he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the friends of Allah, and he said: They are those who, when they are seen, Allah is remembered.
Ibn Zayd said: They are those who believed and were God-fearing, and faith will not be accepted except with taqwā. Some people said: They are those who love one another for the sake of Allah, and this is indicated by what is narrated from ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Among the servants of Allah are people who are neither prophets nor martyrs, whom the prophets and martyrs will envy (in a good sense) on the Day of Resurrection for their station with Allah." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, who are they?" He said: "They are people who loved one another for the sake of Allah without ties of kinship between them and without wealth they exchange. By Allah, their faces are light, and they are upon light; they do not fear when people fear, and they do not grieve when people grieve." And he recited this verse: أَلا إِنَّ أَوْلِياءَ اللَّهِ لا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ.
Abū Bakr al-Aṣamm said: The friends of Allah are those whose guidance Allah has taken charge of, and who have taken charge of fulfilling the right of servitude to Allah and calling to Him.

safi-cedvel:65-65.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (لا) prohibitive, causing the jussive. (يحزن) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (قول) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (إنّ العزّة) like إنّ أولياء, (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of inna. (جميعا) ḥāl (circumstantial) from العزّة [Note: Al-Jamal in his ḥāshiya permitted it to be a tawkīd (emphasis) of العزّة; and the word (جميعا) was not made feminine because it is on the pattern فعيل, in which masculine and feminine are alike.], accusative (manṣūb). (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (السميع) khabar, nominative. (العليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «لا يحزنك ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «إنّ العزّة لله» has no grammatical position; resumptive — or causal (taʿlīliyya) [Note: The maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) is omitted, i.e. "you are not a messenger", or something else.].
The clause «هو السميع ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive and causal.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(ألا إنّ) their i'rab has preceded [Note: In verse (62) of this sūra.], (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, fronted khabar (predicate) of inna. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من. (الواو) conjunction. (من في الأرض) like من في السموات, and maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative [Note: I.e. those whom they made gods and associated with Allah in lordship are not partners in reality, since partnership in divinity is impossible, even if they applied to them the name "partners". It is permissible for (ما) to be an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being يتّبع.. and شركاء the object of يدعون, i.e. "and what thing do those who call upon another god besides Allah follow? They follow nothing".. And al-Zamakhsharī permitted (ما) to be a relative noun in the position of accusative] [Translator's note: the footnote breaks off here in the source.], (يتّبع) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (الذين) a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). (يدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) from شركاء, or from the omitted object of (يدعون), i.e. idols or gods. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (شركاء) mafʿūl bihi of (يدعون) [Note: Or mafʿūl bihi of the verb يتّبع, and the object of يدعون is omitted, its implied form being آلهة.], accusative (manṣūb). (إن) negative. (يتّبعون) like يدعون. (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (الظنّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (إن) like the first. (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (إلّا) like the first. (يخرصون) like يدعون.
The clause «إنّ لله من في السموات» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ما يتّبع الذين ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause [Note: Or it is resumptive if (ما) is parsed as an interrogative noun.. and it is the ṣila of (ما) if it is parsed as a relative noun.].
The clause «يدعون ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إن يتّبعون إلّا الظنّ» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إن هم إلّا يخرصون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause يتّبعون ...
The clause «يخرصون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Benefits:
- The negative إن:
In this verse the negative إن occurs in His saying, Exalted is He, وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ, i.e. "and they are nothing but guessing". We shall clarify what pertains to it. The negative (إن) enters upon the nominal clause, as in His saying, Exalted is He, إِنِ الْكافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ and وَإِنْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتابِ إِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهِ, i.e. "and there is no one of the People of the Book but will surely believe in him"; the mubtadaʾ was omitted and its adjective remained.
It also enters upon the verbal clause, as in His saying, Exalted is He, إِنْ أَرَدْنا إِلَّا الْحُسْنى and إِنْ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِلَّا إِناثاً.
The saying of some that the negative إن only comes when followed by إلا, as in these verses, or by the doubled لمّا which has its meaning, as in His saying, Exalted is He, إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْها حافِظٌ, i.e. "there is no soul but has a guardian over it" — this saying is rejected by the evidence of His saying, Exalted is He, إِنْ عِنْدَكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطانٍ بِهذا and قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ ما تُوعَدُونَ. The conditional and the negative have come together in His saying, Exalted is He, إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولا وَلَئِنْ زالَتا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُما مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ, i.e. "and if they should cease, no one could hold them after Him". The majority of grammarians hold that it is inoperative (muhmala), and this is the view of Sībawayh and al-Farrāʾ; al-Kisāʾī and al-Mubarrad permitted it to operate like laysa, and it was heard from the people of al-ʿĀliya operating like laysa in their saying: «إن أحد خيرا من أحد إلا بالعافية» ("No one is better than another except through well-being").

safi-cedvel:67-67.t:
* I'rab:
(هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). (الذي) a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). (جعل) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو), and it is the referent pronoun. (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جعل), and (اللام) is for ownership (tamlīk). (الليل) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (اللام) the lām of cause (taʿlīl). (تسكنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of cause, and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تسكنوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (جعل) [Note: جعل means "created", and for this reason it sufficed with a single object..
