As for (مبصرا), it is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and it may be a second object if the verb means "made into"; and the second object of the first (جعل) is omitted, i.e. "He made the night dark".].
(الواو) conjunction. (النهار) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb indicated by what precedes it, i.e.:
"He made the day".. (مبصرا) ḥāl [Note: See footnote (1) on the previous page.] [Translator's note: this refers to the print layout; the footnote meant is the preceding note on جعل in this entry.], accusative. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (في) a preposition. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar..
and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (لآيات) the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ) for emphasis, and the noun of inna, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, naʿt (adjective) of آيات. (يسمعون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «هو الذي ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «جعل لكم الليل ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «تسكنوا ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «(جعل) النهار ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the first جعل clause.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ...» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يسمعون» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of قوم.

* Morphology:
(مبصرا), active participle of the quadriliteral أبصر; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Rational majāz (al-majāz al-ʿaqlī): in His saying, Exalted is He, «وَالنَّهارَ مُبْصِراً», the attribution of seeing to the day is figurative, like what is in the saying of Jarīr:
لقد لمتنا يا أم غيلان في السّرى ... ونمت وما ليل المطيّ بنائم
(You blamed us, O Umm Ghaylān, for travelling by night, and you slept — yet the night of the riding camels is not asleep.)
And their saying: "his day is fasting" (نهاره صائم).

safi-cedvel:28-29.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يوم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر» (remember); (نحشر) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is «نحن», for majesty, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and it refers to the creation; (جميعا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), of the object pronoun; (ثمّ) conjunction; (نقول) like «نحشر»; (اللام) preposition; (الذين) relative, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نقول); (أشركوا) like «أحسنوا» [Note: in verse (26) of this sūra.]; (مكانكم) a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning «اثبتوا» (stay firm), transferred from the adverb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, obligatorily latent, its implied form being «أنتم» [Note: or a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being «الزموا» or «لازموا» (keep to).. or it is an adverb of an omitted verb, its implied form being «قفوا» (stand).]; (أنتم) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in the ism fiʿl [Note: or emphasis of the fāʿil of the implied verbs mentioned in the preceding i'rab.]; والواو) conjunction; (شركاء) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the latent pronoun, following it in the nominative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) resumptive; (زيّلنا) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn.. and (نا) is the fāʿil; (بين) adverb of place, accusative, attached to (زيّلنا), and (هم) is like the last «كم»; (الواو) conjunction; (قال) past verb; (شركاء) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) is like «كم»; (ما) negating; (كنتم) past verb, incomplete (nāqiṣ) — abrogating (nāsikh) —, with its noun; (إيّانا) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi; (تعبدون) imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «نحشرهم ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نقول ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «نحشرهم».
The clause «أشركوا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «مكانكم ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «زيّلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قال شركاؤهم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «زيّلنا» ...
The clause «ما كنتم ... تعبدون» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «تعبدون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».
(الفاء) conjunction; (كفى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الباء) redundant preposition; (الله) the Name of Majesty, genitive in form, nominative in position, fāʿil of «كفى»; (شهيدا) tamyīz (specification), accusative [Note: or a ḥāl, accusative.. and see verse (6) of Sūrat al-Nisāʾ.]; (بيننا) like «بينهم», attached to «شهيد»; (الواو) conjunction; (بينكم) like «بينهم», and conjoined to «بيننا»; (إن) lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is an omitted pronoun, i.e. «إنّنا»; (كنّا) like «كنتم»; (عن عبادة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «غافلين», and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) it is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa) that distinguishes the lightened «إن» from others; (غافلين) khabar of «كنّا», accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «كفى بالله ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause «ما كنتم.. تعبدون» [Note: because the speech is still that of the partners who were taken as gods — with the passive voice —.].
The clause «إن كنّا ...» has no grammatical position, having the status of a statement of cause [Translator's note: the source prints «العليليّة», evidently for «التعليليّة» (causal).].
The clause «كنّا ... غافلين» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the lightened «إن».

* Morphology:
(زيّلنا): it has been said that it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its bare form is «زال يزول», and its origin is «زيولنا».. when the yāʾ and the wāw came together and the first of them had sukūn, the wāw was changed into yāʾ and assimilated into the second yāʾ; its pattern is فيعلنا.. And it has been said that its bare form is «زال يزيل»; one says «زلت الشيء عن مكانه أزيله» (I removed the thing from its place); on that basis there is no iʿlāl in it, and its pattern is فعّل with doubling for intensification (takthīr), not for transitivity; and this is the more evident view.

* Benefits:
- Verbal nouns (asmāʾ al-afʿāl):
In this verse comes His saying, the Exalted, مَكانَكُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَشُرَكاؤُكُمْ, and (مكانكم) is a verbal noun of command meaning «الزموا» (keep to). Perhaps it is useful to present the most important matters relating to verbal nouns.
1- Verbal nouns indicate the meaning of the verb and its time, and so they resemble the verb; while they do not accept the particles of the accusative and the jussive, and in this they resemble the noun; hence came their name "nouns of verbs" (asmāʾ al-afʿāl).
2- Verbal nouns are indeclinable according to the vowel of their ending.
3- They are divided into kinds:
a- Improvised (murtajala): those originally coined in the language for this purpose and no other. They are divided into the verbal noun of a past verb, such as: «هيهات», i.e. «بعد» (it is far); the verbal noun of an imperfect verb, such as: «أفّ», i.e. «أتضجّر» (I am vexed); and the verbal noun of an imperative verb, such as: «آمين»: «استجب» (answer).
b- Transferred (manqūla): those transferred from an adverb, such as: «دونك الكتاب»: «خذه» (take it).
And those transferred from a preposition and its genitive noun, such as «إليك عني»: «ابتعد» (go away); and those transferred from a maṣdar, such as: «رويد أخاك»: «أمهل» (give respite); «بله الشرّ»: «اترك» (leave).
c- Regular (qiyāsiyya): taken from the complete, fully conjugated triliteral verb on the pattern (فعال), such as:
«نزال» and «حذار»; and nothing comes on this pattern (فعال) except what conveys command.
Remark: the transferred verbal noun to which the kāf of address is attached — the kāf varies according to the one addressed, in singular, dual and plural, and masculine and feminine. It is a particle with no grammatical position.

safi-cedvel:30-30.t:
* I'rab:
(هنا) demonstrative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place — i.e. in that standing-place — [Note: or it is borrowed for time, i.e. on that day.], attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تبلوا), and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (تبلو) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw; (كلّ) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (نفس) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أسلفت) past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is «هي», i.e. every soul; (الواو) conjunction; (ردّوا) past verb, passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إلى الله) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ردّوا); (مولى) badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الحقّ) naʿt (adjective) of «مولى», genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (ضلّ) past verb; (عن) preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (ضلّ) by its being made to include the meaning of «غاب» (was absent); (ما) relative noun [Note: or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, and the clause after it is a naʿt of it.], in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (كانوا) past verb, incomplete (nāqiṣ), indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the noun of «كان»; (يفترون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «تبلو كلّ ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أسلفت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «ردّوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one.
The clause «ضلّ عنهم ما ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «يفترون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate) of «كانوا».

safi-cedvel:31-31.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (من) interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يرزق) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من السماء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يرزق); (الأرض) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «السماء» by the wāw, genitive like it; (أم) a particle meaning «بل», and it is the disconnected one (munqaṭiʿa), for transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī); (من يملك) like «من يرزق»; (السمع) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (الأبصار) conjoined to «السمع», accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (من يخرج الحيّ) like «من يملك السمع»; (من الميّت) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخرج); (الواو) conjunction; (يخرج الميّت من الحيّ) like its counterpart that preceded; (الواو) conjunction; (من يدبّر الأمر) like «من يملك السمع»; (الفاء) linking (rābiṭa) for the apodosis of an implied condition; (السين) particle of the future; (يقولون) like «يفترون» [Note: in the previous verse (30).]; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. «الله يفعل كلّ ذلك» (Allah does all that) [Note: or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «الفاعل ذلك الله» (the one who does that is Allah).]; (الفاء) conjunction; (قل) like the first; (الهمزة) for the interrogative of rebuke (istifhām tawbīkhī); (الفاء) conjunction; (لا) negating; (تتّقون) like «يفترون» [Note: in the previous verse (30).].
The clause «قل....» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من يرزقكم» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يرزقكم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «من يملك ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive within the scope of the preceding saying.
The clause «يملك ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «من يخرج ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «يخرج ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the third mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «يخرج (the second)» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the first clause «يخرج».
The clause «من يدبّر ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «يدبّر ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the fourth mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «سيقولون ...» is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you ask them that, they will say.
The clause «الله (يفعل ذلك..)» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «قل» (the first).
The clause «أفلا تتّقون» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to an implied clause which is the maqūl al-qawl, i.e.: «أتصرون على الضلال فلا تتقون» (do you persist in misguidance, and so not fear Him?).

safi-cedvel:32-32.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (ذلكم) demonstrative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the reference is to the One who does these things, and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address, and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural; (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (ربّ) badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty, nominative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الحقّ) naʿt (adjective) of «ربّ», nominative; (الفاء) conjunction; (ماذا) interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and in it is the meaning of negation [Note: it is permissible for (ما) to be an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, with the meaning of negation in it, (ذا) a relative noun, khabar, and (بعد) an adverb attached to the ṣila.]; (بعد) adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الحقّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (الضلال) badal of the interrogative noun, following it in the nominative; (الفاء) conjunction; (أنّي) interrogative noun meaning «كيف» (how), in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), its governing word being «تصرفون» [Note: or in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (تصرفون).]; (تصرفون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «ذلكم الله» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ماذا بعد الحقّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one [Note: or it gives the cause (taʿlīliyya) of something implied, i.e. «آمنوا فليس بعد الحقّ إلّا» (believe, for after the truth there is nothing but ...).].
The clause «أنّى تصرفون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.

safi-cedvel:68-68.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (اتّخذ) a past verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (ولدا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) [Note: The verb took a single object because it was made to include the meaning of "adopted" (تبنّى).], (سبحان) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الغنيّ) khabar (predicate), nominative. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ. (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (الواو) conjunction. (ما في الأرض) like ما في السموات, and maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it. (إن) a negating particle. (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (سلطان) genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative in position, a delayed mubtadaʾ. (الباء) a preposition. (ها) a particle of alerting. (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of سلطان. (الهمزة) for reproachful interrogation. (تقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تقولون) by making it include the meaning of "you fabricate" (تفترون). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the referent pronoun is omitted [Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, with the clause as its adjective.], (لا) negative. (تعلمون) like تقولون.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «اتّخذ الله ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «(نسبح) سبحانه» has no grammatical position; parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «هو الغنيّ..» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «له ما في السموات..» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) or causal.
The clause «إن عندكم من سلطان» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تقولون..» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تعلمون» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (ما).

safi-cedvel:69-69.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت). (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. (يفترون) like تقولون «1» [Translator's note: the footnote markers «1» and «3» in this entry have no accompanying footnote text in the source; تقولون and لا تعلمون refer to the previous verse.], (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفترون), (الكذب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) [Note: See verses (50) of Sūrat al-Nisāʾ, (103) of Sūrat al-Māʾida and (60) of this sūra.], (لا يفلحون) like لا تعلمون «3».
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «إنّ الذين ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «يفترون ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا يفلحون» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna.

safi-cedvel:70-70.t:
* I'rab:
(متاع) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "افتراؤهم" (their fabrication). (في الدنيا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of متاع, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (ثمّ) a conjunction. (إلى) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar. (مرجع) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (ثمّ) like the first. (نذيق) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "we" (نحن), for majesty. (العذاب) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الشديد) naʿt of العذاب, accusative. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. (كانوا) an incomplete past verb — abrogating (nāsikh) — and its noun. (يكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (نذيق), i.e. because of their disbelief.
The clause «(ذاك) متاع ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «إلينا مرجعهم» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «نذيقهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يكفرون» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(الكاف) preposition; (ذلك) demonstrative, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing word is «حقّت» [Note: or the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل», a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar since it is its description, i.e. the word of your Lord came true truly, like the turning of those away from faith.]; (حقّت) past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (كلمة) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (على) preposition; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (حقّت); (فسقوا) past verb with its fāʿil; (أنّ) particle resembling the verb — abrogating (nāsikh) —, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of «أنّ»; (لا) negating; (يؤمنون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أنّهم لا يؤمنون) is in the position of the nominative as badal (substitute) of (كلمة) [Note: or in the position of the genitive by an omitted lām of cause, i.e.: because they do not believe.. if (كلمة ربّك) indicates the punishment of Allah.].
The clause «حقّت كلمة..» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «فسقوا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا يؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «أنّ».

safi-cedvel:34-34.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (هل) interrogative particle; (من شركاء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من) relative noun [Note: or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.. and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it.], indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); (يبدأ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is «هو»; (الخلق) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (ثمّ) conjunction; (يعيد) like «يبدأ», and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (قل) like the first; (الله) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يبدأ ... يعيده) like the first; (فأنّى تؤفكون) like «فأنّى تصرفون» [Note: in verse (32) of this sūra.
(2, 3) in the previous verse (34).].
The clause «قل ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هل من شركائكم من..» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يبدأ ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «يعيده» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله يبدأ ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يبدأ الخلق ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله). The clause «يعيده ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause «يبدأ».
The clause «تؤفكون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «قل» (the second).

safi-cedvel:35-35.t:
* I'rab:
(قل.. يهدي) like its counterpart «2»; (إلى الحقّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يهدي); (قل الله..) like its counterpart «3»; (للحقّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the second (يهدي); (الهمزة) for the interrogative; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يهدي إلى الحق) like the first; (أحقّ) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (أن) maṣdar and accusative particle; (يتّبع) imperfect verb, passive, accusative (manṣūb)..
and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو».
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يتّبع) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أحقّ», i.e.: «أحقّ بأن يتّبع» (more worthy of being followed), and the thing surpassed (al-mufaḍḍal ʿalayhi) is omitted, i.e. «ممن لا يهدي» (than one who does not guide) [Note: it is permissible for the word (أحقّ) to be an adjective that does not indicate preference, and in that case there is no need to suppose the omitted thing surpassed.].
(أم) conjunction, the counterpart (muʿādil) of the hamza; (من لا يهدّي) like «من يهدي» [Note: and the khabar of (من) is omitted, its implied form being «أحق أن يتّبع».]; (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أن يهدى) like «أن يتّبع». The interpreted maṣdar (أن يهدى) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, namely the bāʾ, attached to (يهدّي), i.e.: «لا يهدّي إلّا بأن يهدى» [Note: it is possible for (إلّا) to be a particle of exception, and the exception is either disjoined (munqaṭiʿ), so that «إلّا» means «لكن» (but).. or joined (muttaṣil), being an exception from the most general of states, i.e.: one who does not find guidance in any state except in the state of being guided.].
(الفاء) resumptive; (ما) interrogative noun for rebuke and denial, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (اللام) preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «ما»; (كيف) interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of (تحكمون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هل من شركائكم من يهدي» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يهدي ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله يهدي ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «من يهدي ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «هل من شركائكم ...»
The clause «يهدي (the third)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «يتّبع» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «من لا يهدّي» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause «من يهدي ...»
The clause «لا يهدّي» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative (من).
The clause «يهدى (in the passive)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «ما لكم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تحكمون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun of address in (لكم) [Note: it is possible to pause at (لكم).. so the clause after it has no grammatical position, being resumptive.].

* Morphology:
(يهدّي): in it the tāʾ is changed into dāl and assimilated with the second dāl; its origin is «يهتدي». When the assimilation of the two dāls was intended, the first was given sukūn, and the hāʾ before it already had sukūn, so it was given kasra to avoid the meeting of two sukūns; its pattern is يفتعل.
(يهدى), in the passive: it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is «يهدي» with fatḥa on the dāl and ḍamma on the yāʾ, with the implied ḍamma; when the letter before the yāʾ, which was originally voweled, had fatḥa, it was changed into alif; its pattern is يفعل with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Varying the prepositions: this is a topic that contains the secret of varying the prepositions.
Most people put these particles in other than their places, and are ignorant of the subtleties hidden in placing them where they have been placed. Here He made the verb «هدى» transitive to «الحق» with «إلى» twice, and the third time He made it transitive with the lām. The grammarians overlook this secret and say: what may properly be governed by «إلى» may be governed by the lām, which conveys the end-point (ghāya) like it, but not the reverse; so for «قلت له» one does not say «قلت إليه». And they say: «الماء في الكأس» (the water is in the cup), because «في» is for containment (ẓarfiyya), and they allow making it transitive with the bāʾ because it replaces it in containment. But it is not permissible to say for «مررت به»: «مررت فيه». Once this is established we say — and Allah knows best — that there is a secret behind the form: when guidance was ascribed to them, it had to be made transitive with «إلى», which conveys distance, as though it were implicitly far from them; but when it was ascribed to Allah the Exalted, it had to be made transitive with the lām, which conveys nearness, as though it were among His exclusive properties alone and in His possession, and He alone has it in permanence and perfection.

* Benefits:
Solution of a difficulty.
In this verse comes His saying, the Exalted, أَفَمَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّنْ لا يَهِدِّي إِلَّا أَنْ يُهْدى. Someone may say: the idols are inanimate; neither their guiding nor their being guided can be conceived, so how did He say: «إلا أن يهدى»? The scholars have mentioned several ways regarding that:
1- That the meaning of guidance with respect to the idols is moving from place to place, so the meaning is that they do not move except by the act of an agent; thus He, Glorified and Exalted, made clear the helplessness of the idols.
2- That the mention of guidance with respect to the idols is by way of figurative usage (majāz); that is, since the polytheists took the idols as gods and gave them the rank of one who hears and reasons, He expressed them with what is used of one who hears, reasons and knows, and described them with this description, even though the matter is not so.
3- It is possible that what is meant by His saying هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكائِكُمْ مَنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ is the idols, and by His saying هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكائِكُمْ مَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ the leaders of disbelief and misguidance. For Allah, Glorified and Exalted, guided creation to the religion by the proofs He made manifest that point to His oneness; as for the leaders of disbelief and misguidance, they are unable to guide others unless Allah guides them to the truth; so following the religion of Allah and holding fast to His guidance is more fitting than following anything else.

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating particle; (يتّبع) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (أكثر) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ظنّا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb), standing in for the maṣdar because it is its kind, i.e. «إلّا اتباع الظنّ» (only the following of conjecture), and the object of «يتّبع» is omitted, i.e. «يتّبعون الأصنام اتّباع الظنّ» (they follow the idols with the following of conjecture); (إنّ) particle resembling the verb — abrogating (nāsikh) —; (الظنّ) the noun of «إنّ», accusative; (لا) negating; (يغني) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is «هو»; (من الحقّ) preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) of (شيئا) — an adjective placed before the word it qualifies —; (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its description, i.e. it does not avail any availing at all, neither little nor much [Note: or it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if «يغني» is made to include the meaning of «يدفع» (repel).]; (إنّ الله) like «إنّ الظنّ»; (عليم) khabar (predicate) of «إنّ», nominative; (الباء) preposition; (ما) maṣdar particle [Note: or it is a relative noun — or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective — in the position of the genitive, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, and the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) or a naʿt (adjective).]; (يفعلون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (ما يفعلون) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».
The clause «يتّبع أكثرهم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنّ الظنّ لا يغني ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لا يغني ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «إنّ».
The clause «إنّ الله عليم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

safi-cedvel:37-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating; (كان) past verb, incomplete (nāqiṣ) — abrogating (nāsikh) —; (ها) particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) demonstrative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as the noun of «كان»; (القرآن) badal (substitute) of «ذا» — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it —, nominative (marfūʿ); (أن) maṣdar and accusative particle; (يفتري) imperfect verb, passive, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (من دون) preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of the nāʾib fāʿil [Note: or attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفتري).]; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) particle of rectification (istidrāk); (تصديق) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the khabar (predicate) of «كان» [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb.. or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) whose governing word is implied, i.e. «أنزل للتصديق» (it was sent down for confirmation).]; (الذي) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (بين) adverb, accusative, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; (يدي) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يفتري) is in the position of the accusative as khabar of «كان», and this maṣdar has the meaning of the passive participle, i.e. «مفترى» (fabricated).
(الواو) conjunction; (تفصيل) conjoined to «تصديق», accusative, and it takes all its possible parsings; (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (لا) of generic negation; (ريب) the noun of «لا», indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative; (في) preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the khabar of «لا»; (من ربّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تصديق» or to «تفصيل», and it is a case of contention (tanāzuʿ) [Note: it is permissible for the preposition and its genitive noun to be a ḥāl of «الكتاب».]; (العالمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «ما كان هذا القرآن..» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يفتري ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا ريب فيه» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of «الكتاب» [Note: the ḥāl may properly come from the muḍāf ilayhi because the muḍāf governs the muḍāf ilayhi in meaning; and it is permissible for the clause to be resumptive, as it is permissible for it to be parenthetical between a governing word and what it governs, if (من ربّ) is attached to «تفصيل».].

* Morphology:
(يفتري): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is «يفتري» with ḍamma on the first yāʾ and with a final yāʾ retained, and it is treated like «يهدى» [Note: in verse (35) of this sūra.].
(تصديق): the regular maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb «صدّق»; its pattern is تفعيل.

safi-cedvel:71-76.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اتل) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you" (أنت). (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اتل), (نبأ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (نوح) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (إذ) an adverb for past time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to نبأ. (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he". (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قال), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يا) a vocative particle. (قوم) the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on its end, and (الياء), deleted for lightening, is muḍāf ilayhi. (إن) a conditional particle causing the jussive. (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — abrogating (nāsikh) — in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn) [Note: Or a pronoun necessarily latent, implied as "هو", referring to (مقامي), because there is a contention (tanāzuʿ) in the speech between the two verbs (كان، كبر). Also, the verb (كان) may be redundant, for embellishment, not conveying that the noun was characterized by the khabar in past time; on this basis (كبر) is the protasis.], (كبر) like قال. (عليكم) like عليهم, attached to (كبر). (مقامي) fāʿil of كبر, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on what precedes the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (تذكيري) like مقامي, and maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it. (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تذكيري. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (توكلّت), which is a past verb and its fāʿil. (الفاء) conjunction. (أجمعوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn [Translator's note: the source has «حذف حرف النون», "deletion of the letter nūn"], and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أمر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (شركاء) conjoined to أمر, accusative like it [Note: It is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. the affair of your partners.. Some — Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī, followed by Ibn Hishām — permitted its accusative as a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), its governor being أجمعوا, i.e. "resolve upon your affair together with your partners".], and (كم) like the first. (ثمّ) a conjunction. (لا) prohibitive, causing the jussive. (يكن) an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm). (أمر) the noun of yakun, nominative, and (كم) like the first. (عليكم) like عليهم, attached to (غمّة), which is the khabar (predicate) of yakun, accusative. (ثمّ) like the first. (اقضوا) like أجمعوا. (إلى) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (اقضوا), (الواو) conjunction. (لا) like the first. (تنظروا) an imperfect verb, jussive by lā, and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (النون) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء), deleted for lightening, is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «اتل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قال ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يا قوم ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «إن كان ...» has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.
The clause «كبر عليكم مقامي» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كان.
The clause «على الله توكّلت» is in the position of nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "أنا", and the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis [Note: It is permissible for the clause to be parenthetical despite the entry of the fāʾ, and the apodosis is the clause أجمعوا, because Nūḥ's reliance does not depend on the condition.].
The clause «أجمعوا ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «لا يكن أمركم ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause أجمعوا ...
The clause «اقضوا ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause لا يكن أمركم.
The clause «لا تنظرون» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause لا يكن أمركم.
(الفاء) conjunction. (إن تولّيتم) like إن كان.. and (تم) is the fāʿil. (الفاء) linking the apodosis. (ما) negative. (سألت) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (أجر) genitive in form, accusative in position, second mafʿūl bihi. (إن) a negating particle. (أجري) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (الواو) conjunction. (أمرت) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (التاء) a pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle. (أكون) an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative.. and its noun is a latent pronoun, implied as "أنا". (من المسلمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of أكون, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أكون) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb أمرت, i.e. "I was commanded my being a Muslim" [Note: Or it is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition attached to (أمرت), i.e. "I was commanded to be ...".].
The clause «تولّيتم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause of the preceding response to the vocative.
The clause «ما سألتكم ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن أجري إلّا على الله» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «أمرت ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the causal clause.
The clause «أكون ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
(الفاء) conjunction in the two places. (كذّبوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (نجّينا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) like the first. (الواو) conjunction. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, conjoined to the object pronoun in (نجيّناه), (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of من, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (في الفلك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila [Note: It may be attached to (نجيّناه), i.e. the rescue took place in this place.], (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (جعلناهم) like نجيّناه. (خلائف) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and barred from nunation because it is on the form of the ultimate plural pattern (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ). (الواو) conjunction. (أغرقنا) like نجيّنا. (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (كذّبوا) like the first. (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition. (انظر) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you" [Note: The address may be to the Messenger or to the listener.], (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar of kāna. (كان) an incomplete past verb — abrogating. (عاقبة) the noun of kāna, nominative. (المنذرين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «كذّبوه ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause قال in His saying إذ قال.
The clause «نجيّناه ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause كذّبوه.
The clause «جعلناهم..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun, with قد implied.
The clause «أغرقنا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause نجيّنا.
The clause «كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أنظر ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you have taken in the story of Nūḥ's people, then look ...".
The clause «كان عاقبة ...» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative كيف.
(ثمّ) a conjunction. (بعثنا) like نجّينا. (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بعثنا), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (رسلا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (إلى قومهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بعثنا).. and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) conjunction. (جاؤوا) like كذّبوا, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بالبيّنات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاءوهم) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of (جاؤوا), i.e. "bearing the clear proofs".], (الفاء) conjunction. (ما) negative. (كانوا) an incomplete past verb — abrogating ... and the wāw is the noun of kāna. (اللام) the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd) — or of disavowal — (يؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of denial, and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (يؤمنوا), (كذّبوا) like the first. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كذّبوا), (من) a preposition. (قبل) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (كذّبوا) [Note: I.e. before the sending of the messengers to them, and after the messengers came to them with the clear proofs.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يؤمنوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar of كانوا, i.e. they were not fit for faith.
(الكاف) a preposition. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is نطبع.. and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (نطبع) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "we" (نحن), for majesty. (على قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نطبع), (المعتدين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «بعثنا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause أغرقنا ...
The clause «جاءوهم ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause بعثنا.
The clause «ما كانوا ليؤمنوا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause جاءوهم.
The clause «يؤمنوا ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «كذّبوا به» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «نطبع ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(ثمّ بعثنا من بعدهم موسى) like ثمّ بعثنا من بعده رسلا.. and the sign of the accusative in موسى is the fatḥa implied on the alif. (الواو) conjunction. (هارون) conjoined to موسى, accusative. (إلى فرعون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بعثنا), and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa. (الواو) conjunction. (ملئه) conjoined to فرعون, genitive..
and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (بآياتنا) like the preceding, attached to (بعثنا). (الفاء) conjunction. (استكبروا) like كذّبوا. (الواو) conjunction. (كانوا) like the first. (قوما) khabar of kāna, accusative. (مجرمين) naʿt (adjective) of (قوما), accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «بعثنا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause ما كانوا ليؤمنوا.
The clause «استكبروا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause بعثنا.
The clause «كانوا قوما ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause استكبروا.
(الفاء) conjunction. (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when" (حين), containing the sense of condition, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (قالوا), (جاء) a past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الحقّ) fāʿil, nominative. (من عند) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاء), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قالوا) like كذّبوا. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — abrogating. (ها) a particle of alerting. (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis. (سحر) khabar of inna, nominative. (مبين) naʿt of سحر, nominative.
The clause «جاءهم الحقّ ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّ هذا لسحر ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.

* Morphology:
(تذكير), a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb ذكّر; its pattern is تفعيل, by adding the tāʾ to the past form, lightening the kāf and adding a yāʾ before the last letter.
(غمّة), the noun from غمّ عليه الأمر, in the passive, meaning "it was hidden and obscure", and it was used as a derived adjective meaning "hidden and vague". Its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma then sukūn.
(المنذرين), plural of المنذر — with fatḥa on the dhāl — a passive participle from the quadriliteral أنذر in the passive; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Allusive metonymy (al-kināya al-īmāʾiyya): in His saying, Exalted is He, «يا قَوْمِ إِنْ كانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَقامِي», i.e. "my self", since it is originally a noun of place and the self is meant by it by way of allusive metonymy, as one says: "the exalted council" (المجلس السامي).
2- Implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya): in His saying, Exalted is He, «ثُمَّ اقْضُوا إِلَيَّ وَلا تُنْظِرُونِ».
I.e. carry out against me that matter which you want and do not give me respite, since القضاء is from "he settled (قضى) his debt" when he paid it; and in it is an implicit metaphor, with "settling" as the imaginative attribute (takhyīl): the omitted matter is likened to a debt, then the thing likened to it was omitted and one of its properties, namely settling, was taken.

* Benefits:
1- In this verse occurs His saying, Exalted is He, فَأَجْمِعُوا أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكاءَكُمْ. A disagreement arose among the grammarians over the i'rab of (وَشُرَكاءَكُمْ), and we shall cite the aspects of i'rab as Ibn Hishām cited them. He said: وشركاءكم in the accusative: the wāw may be conjoining a single word to a single word, with a muḍāf implied, i.e. "and the affair of your partners", or a clause to a clause, with a verb implied, i.e. "and gather (واجمعوا) your partners", considering that the hamza of the implied verb is a hamzat al-waṣl (connecting hamza).
What necessitates the implication in both ways is that أجمع is used for abstract matters, as in your saying: "they agreed (أجمعوا) on such-and-such a view"; unlike جمع, which is shared between concrete things and abstract matters, by the evidence of His saying, Exalted is He, فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُ and الَّذِي جَمَعَ مالًا وَعَدَّدَهُ. There is also a reading with الشركاء in the nominative, conjoined to the wāw of the plural in (أجمعوا).
Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī cited another aspect, taking the wāw as of accompaniment (maʿiyya) and (شركاءكم) as a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment).
2- Correspondence of form to meaning:
In this verse comes the stance of Nūḥ, upon him be blessings and peace, toward his people. We all know that he remained among them a thousand years less fifty, calling them to good and guidance, but he found from them nothing but obstruction and turning away. Therefore his address to them in this verse reflects his inner stance toward them after he had despaired and knew that none of his people would believe except those who had already believed. Hence the verse, with its long breath, its successive conjunctions and its long clauses, reflects his weariness, upon him be blessings and peace, with them; and thus meaning and form correspond and reflect the psychological state in the most eloquent expression and the most splendid diction.

safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
(الر): disconnected letters with no grammatical position — see the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara — ; (تلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the overt sukūn on the yāʾ deleted because of the meeting of two sukūns, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; the reference is to the verses of the Qur'an; (آيات) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ); (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الحكيم) a naʿt (adjective) of الكتاب, genitive.
[Translator's note: "indeclinable on the overt sukūn on the deleted yāʾ" is as in the source; the intended sense is presumably a sukūn implied on the yāʾ deleted because of the meeting of two sukūns.]
The clause «تلك آيات …» has no grammatical position, being initial (ibtidāʾiyya).

* Morphology:
(الحكيم): a derived adjective, its pattern فعيل in the sense of مفعول, i.e. المحكم with fatḥa on the kāf, i.e. protected from corruption; it may also be in the sense of فاعل, i.e. "the one who judges (الحاكم)", or in the sense of "possessing wisdom/judgement (ذي الحكم)".

* Benefits:
- His saying, the Exalted, (الر): Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī set out several views on its i'rab, which we will present for the sake of benefit and good acquaintance.
1- Each of these disconnected letters is a noun, because each of them indicates a meaning in itself, and they are indeclinable. As for the position of (الر), there are three views:
a- The genitive, by an omitted particle of oath, as they said: «الله ليفعلن» (in the dialect of those who use the genitive).
b- Its position is accusative, and there are two views on this: one of them supposes the omission of the oath [particle], as you say «الله لأفعلنّ»; what makes it accusative is an omitted verb whose implied form is "I have bound myself to Allah (التزمت الله)", i.e. to the oath by Him. The second is that it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its implied form being "recite: الر (اتل: الر)".
c- The nominative, as a mubtadaʾ with what follows it as the khabar.
The meanings of these letters:
The majority of the people of knowledge and exegesis hold that no one knows these letters except Allah, Mighty and Majestic; they are among what Allah has reserved for Himself alone, and they are one of the secrets of the Noble Qur'an. That is why it is said in their exegesis: Allah knows best what He intends and the secrets of His Book. The scholars have mentioned two benefits of the occurrence of these letters at the beginnings of surahs:
1- They indicate that this Qur'an is Arabic, revealed in the language of the Arabs whom it addressed, as if Allah, Mighty and Majestic, were saying to them: We have sent down to you a Qur'an in your language and with your letters, and yet you are unable to produce its like.
2- It was the custom of the Arabs in their poetry and prose to open with what attracts attention and grips the listener; so Allah, Mighty and Majestic, opened some of His surahs with something unfamiliar to the Arabs of that time, and when they heard it they listened attentively, and then the Qur'an would come upon them with its enchanting eloquence. What al-Khāzin mentioned in his exegesis about (الر):
[Translator's note: In the source the sentence about the Qur'an's eloquence runs straight into «ما أورد الخازن في تفسيره حول (الر)», which appears to be a sub-heading; it is set as one here.]
Ibn ʿAbbās and al-Ḍaḥḥāk said its meaning is: "I am Allah, I see (أنا الله أرى)". Ibn ʿAbbās said in another narration from him: (الر), (حم) and (ن) are the letters of «الرحمن» disconnected. Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and Sālim ibn ʿAbd Allāh held the same. Qatāda said: (الر) is one of the names of the Qur'an. It is also said to be a name of the sūra. And Allah knows best.
[Translator's note: The source has «أن الله أرى»; the familiar form of this report is «أنا الله أرى» ("I am Allah, I see"), which the translation follows.]

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); (كان) an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — ; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (عجبا) — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies — ; (عجبا) the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle; (أوحينا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (إلى رجل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوحينا); (من) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive — attached to an adjective of رجل; (أن) an explicative particle (ḥarf tafsīr) [Note: (أن) may be a maṣdar-forming particle which, together with what follows it, is interpreted as a maṣdar, made genitive by an omitted bāʾ, i.e. "We revealed with warning (أوحينا بإنذار)"; this is Abū Ḥayyān's choice in al-Baḥr. It may also be lightened from the heavy (anna), with its noun the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn) omitted, and the interpreted maṣdar likewise made genitive by the omitted bāʾ.] (أنذر) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; (الناس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أوحينا..) is in the position of nominative as the postponed noun of kāna.
(الواو) a conjunction; (بشّر) like أنذر; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — for emphasis; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive — attached to a fronted khabar; (قدم) the postponed noun of anna, accusative; (صدق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to an adjective of قدم صدق; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, in the position of genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ لهم قدم..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted bāʾ, attached to (بشّر), i.e. "give them good news that they have…".
(قال) a past verb; (الكافرون) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (إنّ) like أنّ; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (ساحر) the khabar of inna, nominative; (مبين) a naʿt (adjective) of ساحر, nominative.
The clause «كان للناس عجبا …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أوحينا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «أنذر الناس …» has no grammatical position, being explicative.
The clause «بشّر …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنذر.
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «قال الكافرون …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إنّ هذا لساحر …» is in the position of accusative as the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

* Morphology:
(عجبا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb عجب يعجب, of the فرح class; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas. It is also said to be in the sense of معجب, the passive or the active participle [Note: In this sense it is valid to attach (للناس) to it, because when a maṣdar occurs in the place of an active or passive participle, what it governs may precede it.].
(قدم): a word denoting the well-known body part (the foot); here it is borrowed for every precedence in good. Abū ʿUbayda said: Every precedence in good or evil is, among the Arabs, a قدم.
Al-Layth said: القدم is precedence (السابقة), i.e. good has gone ahead for them with Allah. The reason for applying the word القدم to these meanings is that striving and going ahead happen only by the foot, so the effect was named by the name of the cause, by way of majāz mursal (non-metaphorical figurative usage), just as a favour is called a "hand".

* Rhetoric:
Majāz mursal: in His saying, the Exalted, «أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ», i.e. precedence and a lofty rank with their Lord. It was expressed by it only because by it precedence and arrival at lofty ranks are attained, just as a favour is expressed by "the hand", because giving is done with it; so the relation here is causality. We add here that this majāz is not applied uniformly: it is not correct to say «قدم سوء». This is a remarkable property among the properties of majāz, in which the judgement is almost referred to taste.

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — ; (ربّ) the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الله) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ); (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty; (خلق) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (السموات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (الواو) a conjunction; (الأرض) conjoined to السموات, accusative; (في ستة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلق); (أيام) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (ثمّ) a conjunction; (استوى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil is "he"; (على العرش) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استوى); (يدبّر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he"; (الأمر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (ما) a particle of negation; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (شفيع) genitive in wording, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (إذن) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ذلكم) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ — the reference is to the Creator who disposes — and (اللام) for distance and (كم) a particle of address; (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar, nominative; (ربّكم) a badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty, and muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) to link the effect to the cause [Note: Or connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (2, 3) Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or with no grammatical position, resumptive.], (اعبدوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (الهمزة) for the interrogative; (الفاء) a conjunction; (لا) negative; (تذكّرون) an imperfect verb, nominative, one of the two tāʾs having been deleted from it for lightness, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «إنّ ربّكم الله …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خلق …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «استوى …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يدبّر …» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of (إنّ) «2». The clause «ما من شفيع..» is in the position of nominative as a third khabar of (إنّ) «3».
The clause «ذلكم الله …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اعبدوه» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
"Take heed, and worship Him" [Note: Or it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you acknowledge His divinity, then worship Him".].
The clause «تذكّرون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to something implied, i.e. "Have you been heedless, so that you do not remember?"
[Translator's note: The markers «2» and «3» refer to the second part of the author's note above ("(2, 3) Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl…"), which applies to the clauses «يدبّر» and «ما من شفيع».]

safi-cedvel:4-4.t:
* I'rab:
(إلى) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive — attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); (مرجع) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (جميعا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), of the pronoun of address; (وعد) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (حقّا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (يبدأ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (الخلق) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (يعيد) like يبدأ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (اللام) for explaining cause (taʿlīl); (يجزي) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (آمنوا) a past verb with its fāʿil, and like it (عملوا); (الصالحات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (بالقسط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجزي) [Note: Or to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يجزي or of its object.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجزي) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يعيده).
(الواو) resumptive; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (كفروا) like آمنوا; (لهم شراب) like «إليه مرجع»; (من حميم) a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of شراب; (الواو) a conjunction; (عذاب) conjoined to شراب, nominative; (أليم) a naʿt of عذاب, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, with the clause after it as its ṣila and the referent pronoun implied.], (كانوا) an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the noun of kāna; (يكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to أليم [Note: Or attached to a verb indicated by the speech, i.e. "they were punished for what they used to disbelieve".].
The clause «إليه مرجعكم …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «(وعد) وعد الله» has no grammatical position, being a resumption to emphasise the content of what preceded.
The clause «(حق) حقا» has no grammatical position, to emphasise the content of what preceded.
The clause «إنّه يبدأ …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, having the status of an explanation of cause.
The clause «يبدأ …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «يعيده» is in the position of nominative as a khabar, conjoined to the clause يبدأ.
The clause «يجزي …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «عملوا …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause «كفروا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لهم شراب …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «كانوا يكفرون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يكفرون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

* Rhetoric:
Verbal correspondence (al-munāsaba al-lafẓiyya) between حميم and أليم: correspondence is of two kinds: correspondence in meanings and correspondence in wordings.
Here the correspondence is verbal, which consists in bringing words of matching measure that are not rhymed; it is complete and incomplete. The incomplete kind has occurred more in eloquent speech, because rhyme is not required in it.

safi-cedvel:77-77.t:
* I'rab:
(قال موسى) a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (الهمزة) for disapproving, reproachful interrogation. (تقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (للحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقولون) [Note: I.e. concerning the truth and on its account.], (لمّا جاءكم) like لمّا جاءهم [Note: In the preceding verse (76).], and the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) is omitted, its implied form being: "إنّه لسحر" (it is surely magic). (الهمزة) like the first. (سحر) a fronted khabar (predicate), nominative. (ها) a particle of alerting. (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لا) negative. (يفلح) an imperfect verb, nominative. (الساحرون) fāʿil, nominative, and the wāw is the sign of the nominative.
The clause «قال موسى ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تقولون ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl [Note: Of Mūsā's saying.. As for their saying, it is omitted, indicated by the clause of disapproval; the implied form is "this is magic" or "it is surely magic" — as mentioned —].
The clause «جاءكم ...» is in the position of genitive by the annexation of (لمّا) to it [Note: This adverb is stripped of the condition, so it has no apodosis.].
The clause «أسحر هذا» has no grammatical position; resumptive, falling within the scope of the first saying.
The clause «لا يفلح الساحرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of the addressees, and the link is the wāw.

* Morphology:
(الساحرون), plural of الساحر, an active participle from the triliteral سحر; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
- Omission of the object:
In this verse occurs His saying, Exalted is He, أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جاءَكُمْ أَسِحْرٌ هذا. Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī says of the object of (أتقولون) that it is omitted, i.e. "do you say of it: it is magic?", so the implied clause "هو سحر" is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb أتقولون. Ibn Hishām devoted a section to this matter and explained it, saying: The object is frequently omitted after لو شئت, as in His saying, Exalted is He, فَلَوْ شاءَ لَهَداكُمْ, i.e. "had He willed your guidance". And after the negation of knowledge and the like, as in His saying, Exalted is He, أَلا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ السُّفَهاءُ وَلكِنْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ, i.e. "they do not know that they are fools"; and when it refers back to the relative noun, as in His saying, Exalted is He, أَهذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا, i.e. "sent him". And what refers back to the qualified noun, as in the saying of Jarīr:
أبحت حمى تهامة بعد نجد ... وما شيء حميت بمستباح
(You laid open the preserve of Tihāma after Najd — and nothing you have protected is to be laid open.)
The implied form is "and nothing that you protected it".
Likewise what refers back to the subject of a predication, apart from those two, as in the saying of Imruʾ al-Qays:
فأقبلت زحفا على الركبتين ... فثوب نسيت وثوب أجرّ
(So I came crawling on my knees — a garment I forgot, and a garment I drag.)
The implied form is "a garment I forgot it and a garment I drag it".
It also occurs in scattered places, as in His saying, Exalted is He, فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيامُ شَهْرَيْنِ, i.e. "whoever does not find the neck" (i.e. the freeing of a slave), and His saying, Exalted is He, فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً, i.e. "whoever is not able to fast". Its omission is frequent at verse-endings (fawāṣil), as in His saying, Exalted is He, وَما قَلى, i.e. "nor has He hated you". Both objects of أعطى may be omitted, as in His saying, Exalted is He, فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطى; and only the second of them, as in His saying, Exalted is He, وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ; and only the first of them — contrary to al-Suhaylī — as in His saying, Exalted is He, حَتَّى يُعْطُوا الْجِزْيَةَ, i.e. "until they give you the jizya".

safi-cedvel:78-78.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). (الهمزة) for interrogation. (جئت) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (اللام) the lām of cause (taʿlīl). (تلفت) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the fāʿil is "you". (نا) like the first. (عن) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تلفت), (وجدنا) a past verb and its fāʿil. (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from آباء [Note: Or a second object of the verb وجدنا, which takes two objects.], (آباء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) conjunction. (تكون) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (تلفت), (اللام) a preposition and (كما) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb. (الكبرياء) the noun of takūn, nominative (marfūʿ). (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from الكبرياء [Note: Or attached to الكبرياء.. or to a ḥāl from the pronoun of the addressee in (لكما).] [Translator's note: the source has «الخاطب» for «المخاطب».], (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative, operating like laysa. (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the noun of mā. (لكما) like the first, attached to مؤمنين. (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (مؤمنين) genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative in position, khabar of mā, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تلفتنا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (جئتنا).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «جئتنا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «تلفتنا» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «وجدنا» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «تكون لكما الكبرياء» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause تلفتنا.
The clause «ما نحن.. بمؤمنين» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause [Note: It is permissible for the clause to be a ḥāl from the pronoun of address in (لكما).].

* Morphology:
(الكبرياء), an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb كبر يكبر, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعلياء with kasra on the fāʾ. By it, in the noble verse, kingship is intended, because it is the greatest thing sought in this world.

* Rhetoric:
Al-majāz al-mursal (metonymic trope): in His saying, Exalted is He, «قالُوا أَجِئْتَنا لِتَلْفِتَنا عَمَّا وَجَدْنا عَلَيْهِ آباءَنا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا الْكِبْرِياءُ فِي الْأَرْضِ».
I.e. "and that kingship be yours, you and your brother": He expressed it with "grandeur" (الكبرياء) and meant kingship, because grandeur is caused by it. So the relation is that of causation (musabbabiyya).

safi-cedvel:38-38.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) it is the disconnected one (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل», for transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī); (يقولون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (افترى) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is «هو»; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; (الفاء) linking (rābiṭa) for the apodosis of an implied condition; (ائتوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بسورة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ائتوا); (مثل) naʿt (adjective) of «سورة», genitive (majrūr), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (ادعوا) like «ائتوا»; (من) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (استطعتم) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, with its fāʿil; (من دون الله) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in the previous verse (38).] [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase was parsed in verse (37).], attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative; (إن) jussive conditional particle; (كنتم) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of «كان»; (صادقين) khabar (predicate) of «كنتم», accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «يقولون ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «افتراه» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ائتوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. if you are truthful, then bring.
The clause «ادعوا ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ائتوا».
The clause «استطعتم....» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position, a resumptive ṣila [Translator's note: so in the source («صلة استئنافيّة»); evidently «resumptive» is meant.] [Note: or an explanation of the implied condition mentioned earlier.].. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what is mentioned, i.e. if you are truthful that it is a fabrication, then bring a sūra like it.

* Morphology:
(فأتوا): the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) was deleted because of the entry of the fāʾ on the verb; its origin is «ائتوا»; when the fāʾ entered, the connecting hamza was deleted and the second hamza was written on an alif [Note: see verse (23) of Sūrat al-Baqara.]

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
