(بل) particle of digression (iḍrāb); (كذّبوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الباء) preposition; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبوا); (لم) particle of negation and jussive; (يحيطوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بعلم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحيطوا), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) of ḥāl (circumstantial); (لمّا) like «لم»; (يأت) imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (تأويل) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) is like the last one; (الكاف) preposition; (ذلك) demonstrative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted «مطلق» [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e. an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).] whose governing word is «كذّب».. and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (كذّب) past verb; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (من قبل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (انظر) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; (كيف) interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate) of «كان»; (كان) past verb, incomplete (nāqiṣ) — abrogating (nāsikh) —; (عاقبة) the noun of «كان», nominative; (الظالمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «كذّبوا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لم يحيطوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يأتهم تأويله» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يحيطوا» [Note: or it has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause.].
The clause «كذّب الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «انظر ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to a resumptive clause, i.e. «تنبّه فانظر» (take heed, and look) [Note: or it is conjoined to the clause «كذّب الذين».. because it is performative (inshāʾiyya) in wording and declarative (khabariyya) in meaning, and its meaning is: We destroyed them.].
«كان عاقبة ...» is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi whose governing word is «انظر», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative «كيف».

* Rhetoric:
- «لما» in His saying, the Exalted, «بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِما لَمْ يُحِيطُوا بِعِلْمِهِ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُ» has a wondrous secret; it gave the speech a meaning that could not have come about but for its entry, because it conveys expectation after the negation of encompassing its knowledge. It conveyed the following matters: 1- That they denied it on first impulse, before reflection and knowing its interpretation. 2- In imitation of their forefathers. 3- Denial before encompassing its knowledge might suggest some excuse for the denial, so the word «لما» came signalling that they had encompassed its knowledge, so that their excuses would be cut off and their wretchedness be established.

safi-cedvel:40-41.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من) preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) [Note: or attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted khabar, i.e. «بعض منهم» (some of them).]; (من) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); (يؤمن) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو», and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); (الباء) preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يؤمن); (الواو) conjunction; (منهم من لا يؤمن به) like its affirmative counterpart; (الواو) resumptive; (ربّ) mubtadaʾ; (الكاف) pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أعلم) khabar, nominative; (بالمفسدين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أعلم», the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «منهم من يؤمن ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يؤمن به» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «منهم من لا يؤمن ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one.
The clause «لا يؤمن به» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «ربّك أعلم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: it is permissible for it to be parenthetical between two conjoined elements.].
(الواو) conjunction; (إن) jussive conditional particle; (كذّبوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الفاء) linking (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; (اللام) preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a fronted khabar; (عمل) delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on its end, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لكم عملكم) like «لي عملي»; (أنتم) detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (بريئون) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (من) preposition; (ما) maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of the genitive, and the referent pronoun is omitted, and the clause after it is a ṣila.]; (أعمل) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنا»; (الواو) conjunction; (أنا بريء مما تعملون) like its counterpart that preceded.. and (تعملون) is an imperfect verb, nominative, with its fāʿil.
The clause «كذّبوك ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «منهم من يؤمن ...»
The clause «قل ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لي عملي» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لكم عملكم» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «أنتم بريئون ...» has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «أعمل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first particle relative (ما).
The clause «أنا بريء ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أنتم بريئون».
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(أعلم): an adjective that came on the pattern of the elative (tafḍīl), but preference is not intended by it; rather description is intended, i.e. «عالم» (knowing); its pattern is أفعل. (بريئون): plural of «بريء».. see verse (112) of Sūrat al-Nisāʾ.

safi-cedvel:42-43.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (منهم من) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (40) of the sūra.]; (يستمعون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إلى) preposition, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يستمعون); (الهمزة) for the interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī); (الفاء) resumptive; (أنت) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تسمع) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is «أنت», a latent (mustatir) pronoun; (الصمّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (لو) non-jussive conditional particle; (كانوا) past verb, incomplete (nāqiṣ), indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the noun of «كان»; (لا) negating; (يعقلون) like «يستمعون».
The clause «منهم من ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a previous resumption.
The clause «يستمعون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «أنت تسمع ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تسمع الصمّ» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «أنت».
The clause «كانوا لا يعقلون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أنت تسمع».
The clause «لا يعقلون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of «كانوا».. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «فأنت لا تسمع الصمّ» (then you do not make the deaf hear).
(الواو) conjunction; (منهم من ينظر إليك) like «منهم من يؤمن به» [Note: in verse (40) of this sūra.]; (أفأنت تهدي.. لا يبصرون) like its counterpart that preceded.
The clause «منهم من ينظر ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «منهم من يستمعون».
The clause «ينظر إليك ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «أنت تهدي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تهدي العمي ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنت).
The clause «كانوا لا يبصرون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أنت تهدي».
The clause «لا يبصرون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of «كانوا».

* Rhetoric:
The representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ» to the end of the verse there is a representational metaphor. He likened them, in their not being guided, to the deaf and the blind — indeed they are worse, for it is not the eyes that are blind, but the hearts within the breasts are blind; and because the deaf person who has reason may perhaps use perspicacity (firāsa) to infer, and the blind person who has insight in his heart may guess and surmise. The thing likened to came compound because the thing likened is also compound.

safi-cedvel:44-44.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) particle resembling the verb — abrogating (nāsikh) —; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, the noun of «إنّ», accusative (manṣūb); (لا) negating; (يظلم) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (الناس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its description; (الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ) like «إنّ», and for rectification (istidrāk); (الناس) the noun of «لكنّ», accusative; (أنفس) fronted mafʿūl bihi [Note: or a semantic tawkīd (emphasis) of «الناس», accusative like it.], accusative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (يظلمون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «إنّ اللَّه لا يظلم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا يظلم ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
The clause «لكنّ الناس.. يظلمون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one. The clause «يظلمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «لكنّ».

safi-cedvel:5-5.t:
* I'rab:
(هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); (جعل) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he", and it is the referent pronoun; (الشمس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (ضياء) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "possessing radiance (ذات ضياء)" [Note: (ضياء) may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) if (جعل) means "created".], (الواو) a conjunction; (القمر نورا) like «الشمس ضياء» and conjoined to it; (الواو) a conjunction; (قدّر) like جعل, and the fāʿil is "he", and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (منازل) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قدّره) [Note: Or it is a ḥāl, i.e. "moving from stage to stage"; or a mafʿūl bihi, with the third-person pronoun in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "He determined for it stations (قدّر له منازل)"; or a second object if the verb means "made it (جعله)".], (اللام) the lām of explaining cause (taʿlīl); (تعلموا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the subjunctive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عدد) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (السنين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الواو) a conjunction; (الحساب) conjoined to عدد, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تعلموا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (قدّره).
(ما) a particle of negation; (خلق) like جعل; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty; (يفصّل) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he"; (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يفصّل); (يعلمون) like يكفرون [Note: In the previous verse (4).].
The clause «هو الذي …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «جعل الشمس …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «قدّره …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «ما خلق الله …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يفصّل …» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty.
The clause «يعلمون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

* Morphology:
(الشمس): a primitive (jāmid) noun denoting a concrete thing; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ضياء): the maṣdar (verbal noun) of ضاء يضوء; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ. It may also be a noun for that by which the eye perceives things. The yāʾ in it is changed from a wāw because the letter before it has kasra; its origin is ضواء — with kasra on the ḍād — and the hamza at its end is radical.
(القمر): a primitive noun denoting a concrete thing; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(منازل): plural of منزل, a noun of place from نزل ينزل, of the ضرب class; its pattern is فعل with kasra on the ʿayn, because its imperfect has kasra on the ʿayn.
[Translator's note: The source gives the pattern as «فعل»; the pattern of منزل is مفعل (with kasra on the ʿayn).]
(عدد): the noun from عدّ يعدّ, of the نصر class; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas; its plural is أعداد, on the measure أفعال.

* Benefits:
The inimitability of the Qur'an.
In this verse there occurs His saying, the Exalted, هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ ضِياءً وَالْقَمَرَ نُوراً وَقَدَّرَهُ مَنازِلَ لِتَعْلَمُوا عَدَدَ السِّنِينَ وَالْحِسابَ.
This verse contains a precision of expression and a soundness of meaning that prove decisively that the Noble Qur'an is the speech of Allah, and that it issues from the Creator of the universe, including the sun and the moon. The scholars have set out the difference between the meanings of الضياء and النور, and mentioned that الضياء is more complete and more general than النور, brighter and stronger, while النور is below it. Night and day follow from that: if the light of the sun and the moon were one and the same, there would be no distinction between night and day. The verse also contains astronomical indications in His saying, the Exalted, وَقَدَّرَهُ مَنازِلَ لِتَعْلَمُوا عَدَدَ السِّنِينَ وَالْحِسابَ: the Lord, Mighty and Majestic, has made for the moon stations and positions from which follows the knowledge of the lunar months and lunar years, and this happens with regular constancy, without defect or irregularity, without deviation or swerving. Countless years have passed upon that, and we are still with this fixed, precise order that never fails. It was not for a human being to produce the like of this speech, however much wisdom and decisive speech he may have been given.

safi-cedvel:6-6.t:
* [Note: See also verse (190) of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān.]
I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (في اختلاف) a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate); (الليل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction; (النهار) conjoined to الليل, genitive; (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, conjoined to اختلاف; (خلق) a past verb; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلق); (الواو) a conjunction; (الأرض) conjoined to السموات, genitive; (اللام) the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ), for emphasis; (آيات) the postponed noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (لقوم يتّقون) like «لقوم يعلمون» [Note: In the previous verse.], and the preposition phrase is an adjective of آيات.
The clause «إنّ في اختلاف … لآيات» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خلق اللَّه …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يتّقون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

safi-cedvel:7-8.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) like the previous [Note: In the previous verse (6).], (الذين) a relative noun, the noun of inna; (لا) negative; (يرجون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (لقاء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (رضوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (بالحياة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رضوا); (الدنيا) a naʿt (adjective) of الحياة, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) a conjunction; (اطمأنوا) like رضوا; (الباء) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive — attached to (اطمأنّوا); (الواو) a conjunction; (الذين) like the first and conjoined to it; (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (عن آيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (غافلون), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (غافلون) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «إنّ الذين …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا يرجون …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «رضوا …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «اطمأنّوا …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause [Note: The wāw may be circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of رضوا, with قد implied.]. The clause «هم.. غافلون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
(أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address; (مأوى) a second mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif, and (هم) attached, muḍāf ilayhi; (النار) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ مأوى; (الباء) a preposition; (ما كانوا يكسبون) like «ما كانوا يكفرون» [Note: In verse (4) of this sūra. (3, 4) In verse (7) of this sūra.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted verb indicated by the speech, i.e. "they were punished for what they used to…".
The clause «أولئك مأواهم النار …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «مأواهم النار …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «كانوا يكسبون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يكسبون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
[Translator's note: The note part "(3, 4) In verse (7) of this sūra" belongs to footnote markers that do not appear in this entry.]

safi-cedvel:79-86.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (قال) a past verb. (فرعون) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and barred from nunation because of being a proper name and foreign (diptote). (ائتوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ائتوا), (ساحر) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (عليم) naʿt (adjective) of ساحر, genitive.
The clause «قال فرعون ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ائتوني ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
(الفاء) conjunction. (لمّا جاء السحرة) the i'rab of its counterpart has preceded [Note: In verse (76) of this sūra.], (قال..
موسى) its i'rab has preceded [Note: In verse (77) of this sūra.], (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (قال), (ألقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (ملقون) khabar (predicate), nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «جاء السحرة ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the conditional clause, its protasis and its apodosis are conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "so they came to him, and when the sorcerers came ...".
The clause «قال لهم موسى ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ألقوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أنتم ملقون» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما), and the referent pronoun is omitted.
(الفاء) conjunction. (لمّا ألقوا قال موسى) like its preceding counterpart. (ألقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters..
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ [Note: Or it is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ — and this is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān — or in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), and (السحر) is khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "it is magic".. and the clause "it is magic" is a badal (substitute) of the interrogative clause "what have you brought?" It is permissible for (السحر) to be a badal of (ما), with the interrogative hamza implied, and it is nominative.], (جئتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and its fāʿil. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (جئتم), (السحر) khabar of the mubtadaʾ ما. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb). (السين) a particle of the future. (يبطل) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he", and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (إنّ الله) like the first. (لا) negative. (يصلح) like يبطل. (عمل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (المفسدين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «لما ألقوا قال موسى ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لما جاء السحرة.
The clause «ألقوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال موسى ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ما جئتم به السحر ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «جئتم ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (ما) [Note: Or khabar of the interrogative (ما).].
The clause «إنّ الله سيبطله» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «سيبطله» is in the position of nominative as khabar of inna.
The clause «إنّ الله ...» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يصلح عمل ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the (second) inna.
(الواو) conjunction. (يحقّ) an imperfect verb, nominative. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الحقّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, by making the verb include the meaning of "makes manifest" (يظهر). (بكلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحقّ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (كره) a past verb. (المجرمون) fāʿil, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «يحقّ الله الحقّ ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause إنّ الله سيبطله.
The clause «كره المجرمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الحقّ, and the link is the wāw.
(الفاء) conjunction. (ما) negative. (آمن) a past verb. (لموسى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمن) by making it include the meaning of "submitted and yielded", and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa implied on the alif. (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (ذريّة) fāʿil, nominative. (من قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, naʿt of ذريّة, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi and refers to Mūsā or to Pharaoh, there being disagreement about that [Note: Ibn Ḥayyān said: «The pronoun in قومه refers to Mūsā and does not refer to Pharaoh, because Mūsā is the one being spoken about in this verse and he is the nearest mentioned; had it referred to Pharaoh, the construction would have been: على خوف منه ومن ملئهم..» End quote. Among those who hold that the pronoun refers to Pharaoh is Ibn ʿAṭiyya..] [Translator's note: the source has «ابن حيّان»; the quoted view is that of Abū Ḥayyān, who is cited elsewhere in this entry.], (على خوف) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from ذريّة, i.e. fearing Pharaoh. (من فرعون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خوف, and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa. (الواو) conjunction. (ملئهم) conjoined to فرعون.. and a muḍāf ilayhi [Note: The reference of this pronoun is also disputed. Some said it refers to the sense of "Pharaoh's people", and others said it refers to the offspring (الذرّية)..], (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle. (يفتن) an imperfect verb, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he", i.e. Pharaoh. The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفتنهم) is in the position of genitive as a badal of فرعون, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar خوف.].
(الواو) parenthetical. (إنّ فرعون) like إنّ الله. (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). (عال) khabar of inna, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the deleted yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ) with nunation. (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عال. (الواو) conjunction. (إنّه لمن المسرفين) like إنّ الله لعال.. the noun is a pronoun and the khabar is a preposition and its genitive noun, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «ما آمن.. إلّا ذريّة» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause: لما ألقوا قال.
The clause «يفتنهم ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «إنّ فرعون لعال» has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
The clause «إنّه لمن المسرفين» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the parenthetical clause.
(الواو) conjunction. (قال موسى) like قال فرعون, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the alif, and it is barred from nunation because of being a proper name and foreign. (يا) a vocative particle. (قوم إن) their i'rab has preceded [Note: In verse (71) of this sūra.], (كنتم) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — abrogating (nāsikh) — in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) is the noun of kāna. (آمنتم) a past verb and its fāʿil. (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنتم), (الفاء) linking the apodosis. (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (توكلّوا), which is an imperative, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إن كنتم) like the first. (مسلمين) khabar of كنتم, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The vocative clause is parenthetical [Note: Or it is the maqūl al-qawl, and the clause إن كنتم.. has no grammatical position as the response to the vocative.].
The clause «قال موسى ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause ما آمن ...
The clause «إن كنتم ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «آمنتم بالله» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كنتم.
The clause «توكلّوا» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كنتم مسلمين» has no grammatical position; a resumption to emphasize the first condition, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the first condition.
(الفاء) conjunction. (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil. (على الله) like the first, attached to (توكّلنا), which is a past verb and its fāʿil. (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative — the vocative particle is omitted from it — and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (لا) prohibitive, causing the jussive, of supplication. (تجعل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "you". (فتنة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (للقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of فتنة. (الظالمين) naʿt of القوم, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause قال موسى.
The clause «توكّلنا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The vocative clause «ربّنا» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «لا تجعلنا ...» has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.
(الواو) conjunction. (نجّ) an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is "you", and it is indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (برحمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from the object of نجّنا, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (من القوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نجّنا), (الكافرين) naʿt of القوم, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «نجّنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا تجعلنا ...

* Morphology:
(ملقون), plural of الملقي, active participle from the quadriliteral ألقى; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion to suit the plural, for it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ): the yāʾ was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. Its origin is الملقيون; the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made vowelless and its vowel was transferred to the qāf after making it vowelless; then when two vowelless letters met, the yāʾ was deleted, and it became الملقون, its pattern being المفعون.
(عال) active participle from the triliteral علا يعلو; its pattern is فاع. It contains iʿlāl by qalb (conversion) and iʿlāl by deletion. Its form with (ال) is العالي, originally العالو with kasra on the lām; what precedes the vowelless wāw was given kasra, because of the implied vowel, so the wāw was converted to yāʾ — iʿlāl by qalb — and when the definite article (ال) was removed and it was intended to be given nunation, the vowellessness of the weak letter met the vowellessness of the nunation, so the yāʾ was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. The said nunation is the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), not the nunation of full declension (tanwīn al-tamkīn), i.e. compensation for the deleted yāʾ.
(نجّنا), contains iʿlāl by deletion to suit the indeclinable form; its imperfect is ينجّي, and when it passed to the imperative it was made indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter; its pattern is فعّنا.

* Rhetoric:
Majāz and the appended parenthesis (al-iʿtirāḍ al-tadhyīlī): in His saying, Exalted is He, «وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعالٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ».
The use of "loftiness" for domination and subjugation is a well-known majāz, and the two clauses are an appended parenthesis confirming the content of what preceded, and they contain emphasis that is not hidden.

safi-cedvel:45-48.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يوم) adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يتعارفون), which comes later [Note: or it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر لهم» (remind them) or «أنذرهم» (warn them).]; (يحشر) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو», i.e. Allah; (كأن) lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is an omitted pronoun, its implied form being «هم»; (لم) particle of negation and jussive; (يلبثوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ساعة) adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يلبثوا); (من النهار) preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of «ساعة»; (يتعارفون) like «يظلمون» [Note: in verse (44) of the sūra.]; (بين) adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يتعارفون), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قد) particle of verification (taḥqīq); (خسر) past verb; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (كذّبوا) past verb with its fāʿil; (بلقاء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا); (اللَّه) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating particle; (كانوا) past verb, incomplete (nāqiṣ), indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the noun of «كان»; (مهتدين) khabar (predicate) of «كانوا», accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «يحشرهم ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كأن لم يلبثوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the third-person pronoun.
The clause «لم يلبثوا ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the lightened «كأن».
The clause «يتعارفون» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: if (يوم) is attached to the omitted verb, then the clause here is a concurrent or an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqārina aw muqaddara).].
The clause «خسر الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ما كانوا مهتدين» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «خسر الذين»..
(الواو) conjunction; (إن) jussive conditional particle; (ما) redundant (zāʾida); (نرينّ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and the nūn is for emphasis, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بعض) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الذي) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (نعد) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is «نحن», for majesty, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (أو) conjunction; (نتوفّينّك) like «نرينّك»; (الفاء) linking (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إلى) preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a fronted khabar; (مرجع) delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ثمّ) conjunction; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (شهيد) khabar, nominative; (على) preposition; (ما) maṣdar particle [Note: or it is a relative noun, and the clause is a ṣila, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. «يفعلونه».]; (يفعلون) like «يظلمون» [Note: in verse (44) of this sūra.].
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (ما يفعلون) is in the position of the genitive by (على), attached to «شهيد».
The clause «نرينّك ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يتعارفون» [Note: or to the implied clause (اذكر ... or أنذر) if the clause «يتعارفون» is a ḥāl.].
The clause «نعدهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «نتوفّينّك» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «نرينّك».
The clause «إلينا مرجعهم» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «اللَّه شهيد» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «يفعلون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
(الواو) conjunction; (لكلّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar; (أمّة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (رسول) delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to (قضي); (جاء) past verb; (رسول) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قضي) past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted, its implied form being «القضاء» (the judgment); (بين) adverb of place, accusative, attached to (قضي), and (هم) is like the last one; (بالقسط) preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil [Note: or attached to the verb «قضي».]; (الواو) of ḥāl; (هم) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (لا) negating; (يظلمون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «لكلّ أمّة رسول» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to a preceding resumption.
The clause «جاء رسولهم ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قضي بينهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «هم لا يظلمون» is in the position of the accusative as an emphatic ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida).
The clause «لا يظلمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هم».
(الواو) conjunction; (يقولون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (متى) interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time, attached to an omitted khabar; (ها) particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) demonstrative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as delayed mubtadaʾ; (الوعد) badal (substitute) of «ذا» — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) —, nominative; (إنّ) jussive conditional particle [Translator's note: so in the source with shadda; the verse has «إن».]; (كنتم) past verb, incomplete — abrogating (nāsikh) —, indeclinable on sukūn.. and (تم) is the noun of «كان», and the verb is in the position of the jussive as protasis; (صادقين) khabar of «كنتم», accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «لكلّ أمّة رسول».
The clause «متى هذا الوعد..» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of the saying..
and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: «فمتى يحلّ العذاب» (then when will the punishment fall?).

* Benefits:
Emphasizing the imperfect verb with the nūn: in this noble verse comes the emphasis of the imperfect verb with the heavy nūn of emphasis [Translator's note: the source prints «الثقلية», for «الثقيلة» (heavy).] in His saying, the Exalted, وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ, and we will explain below the rule for emphasizing the imperfect verb.
1- Emphasizing the imperfect is obligatory if it occurs as the response to an oath, indicating the future, not negated, and not separated from the lām of the oath by anything separating, as in His saying, the Exalted: فو ربك لنحشرنّهم والشياطين.
2- Emphasizing the imperfect is permissible in the following cases:
a- After the conditional «إن» merged with the redundant «ما», as has passed in the verse. b- After the prohibitive (لا), as in: «لا تصاحبنّ الأشرار» (do not befriend the wicked).
c- After an interrogative, as in: «هل تكرمنّ الضيف» (will you honour the guest?). Remark:
1- If the imperfect is attached to the nūn of emphasis, it is indeclinable on the fatḥa.
2- The nūn of emphasis is of two kinds: heavy, which is the doubled one, and light, which is the one with sukūn; and both come together in His saying, the Exalted, لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُوناً مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (لا) negating particle; (أملك) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is «أنا»; (لنفس) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أملك), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on its end because the place is occupied by the appropriate vowel, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ضرّا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation; (نفعا) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the object, accusative like it; (إلّا) particle of exception; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as an exception, disjoined (munqaṭiʿ) or joined (muttaṣil) [Note: it is disjoined in the view of al-Zamakhsharī, i.e. but what Allah wills of that comes to be, so how could I have power to bring you harm — and for every nation there is a term.. And it is joined in the view of Ibn Ḥayyān, i.e. except what Allah wills that I should have power over and be able to do.
(2, 3) in verse (47) of this sūra.] [Translator's note: so in the source, «ابن حيّان»; elsewhere the author cites Abū Ḥayyān.]; (شاء) past verb; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (لكلّ أمّة أجل) like «لكلّ أمّة رسول» «2»; (إذا جاء أجلهم) like «إذا جاء رسولهم» «3»; (الفاء) linking (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) negating; (يستأخرون) like «يقولون» [Note: in the previous verse (48).]; (ساعة) adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يستأخرون); (الواو) conjunction; (لا يستقدمون) like «لا يستأخرون».
The clause «قل ...» is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.
The clause «لا أملك ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «شاء اللَّه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لكلّ أمّة أجل..» has no grammatical position, having the status of a statement of cause (taʿlīl).
The clause «جاء أجلهم..» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا يستأخرون» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا يستقدمون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis clause.

* Rhetoric:
Metonymy (al-kināya): in His saying, the Exalted, «فَلا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ ساعَةً وَلا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ» there is a metonymy for its having a fixed limit and an appointed term which it does not go beyond, regardless of advancing or delaying, like the saying of the poet of the Ḥamāsa: وقف الهوى بي حيث أنت فليس لي ... متقدم عنه ولا متأخر (Love has halted me wherever you are, so I have neither going ahead of it nor falling behind)
For he meant: love has confined me in the place where you settle, so I keep to it and do not leave it; and I am with you whether you stay or depart; I do not turn away from you nor incline to anyone else.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) like the previous one [Note: in the previous verse (49).]; (الهمزة) for the interrogative; (رأيتم) past verb with its fāʿil (agent) — meaning «أخبروني» (tell me) [Note: al-Ḥūfī said the seeing is the seeing of the heart, which means knowledge, because it enters upon an interrogative clause that has the meaning of affirmation (taqrīr); so the verb of seeing, in al-Ḥūfī's view, remains on its meaning and does not include the meaning of «أخبروني», and the interrogative clause stands in place of the two objects.] — ; (إن) jussive conditional particle; (أتى) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عذاب) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بياتا) adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أتاكم); (أو) conjunction; (نهارا) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the adverb, accusative, attached to what the first is attached to; (ماذا) interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: (ماذا) was parsed as mubtadaʾ and not parsed as mafʿūl bihi because the object is a pronoun referring to the punishment, i.e.: «يستعجله منه المجرمون».. Abū Ḥayyān, however, allowed (ماذا) to be a mafʿūl bihi, as though it were said: what thing of the punishment do the criminals seek to hasten? — and that is his preferred view.]; (يستعجل) imperfect verb, nominative; (من) preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted object, i.e.: «يستعجله منه»; (المجرمون) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قل» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أرأيتم ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أتاكم عذابه» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: if the punishment of Allah comes to you, then tell me about it: what of it do the criminals seek to hasten? [Note: see further explanation and i'rab of this expression in verse (40) of Sūrat al-Anʿām.. And it is permissible for the implied apodosis to be indicated by the content of the coming interrogative, i.e.: «فماذا يستعجل المجرمون» (then what do the criminals seek to hasten?), or «استعجلتموه» (you sought to hasten it).].
The clause «ماذا يستعجل ...» is in the position of the accusative as second mafʿūl bihi of the verb «أرأيتم» [Note: as for the first object, it is omitted in the view of Abū Ḥayyān and not made a pronoun, because making it a pronoun is restricted to poetry or rare in speech; and it is an obligatorily latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the word (عذابه) in the view of others than Abū Ḥayyān. The speech is a case of contention (tanāzuʿ) between the two verbs (رأيتم) and (أتاكم), and the second was given governance, since that is the preferred choice in the school of the Basrans and is what is attested in usage more than giving governance to the first; so when the second was given governance, [the first's object] was omitted and not made a pronoun in the view of Abū Ḥayyān. The meaning is: say to them, O Muḥammad, tell me about the punishment of Allah: if it comes to you, what of it do you seek to hasten? — or it was made a pronoun according to another view.].
The clause «يستعجل ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (ماذا).

safi-cedvel:9-10.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ الذين): its i'rab has already been given «3»; (آمنوا) like رضوا «4», and likewise (عملوا); (الصالحات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (يهدي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (ربّ) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (بإيمان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يهدي), the bāʾ being causal, and (هم) like the last; (تجري) like يهدي; (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري) [Note: Or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الأنهار — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies.], and (هم) like the last; (الأنهار) fāʿil, nominative; (في جنّات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of الأنهار [Note: Or attached to (تجري); it may also be another khabar of (إنّ).], (النعيم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
[Translator's note: The markers «3» and «4» refer to the author's footnotes printed under the previous entry (verses 7–8): "(3, 4) In verse (7) of this sūra."]
The clause «إنّ الذين آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «عملوا …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يهديهم ربّهم …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «تجري.. الأنهار» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: Or in the position of nominative as a second khabar of (إنّ), or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the object of يهديهم.].
(دعوى) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive — attached to دعوى; (سبحان) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "we glorify (نسبّح)", and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللهمّ) the Name of Majesty, the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative, and (الميم) with shadda is a substitute for the omitted (يا); (الواو) a conjunction; (تحيّتهم فيها) like «دعواهم فيها» [Note: The preposition phrase may be a ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in تحيّتهم.], (سلام) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ تحيّة, nominative [Note: Or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "peace be upon you (سلام عليكم)", and the clause is the khabar of تحيّتهم.], (الواو) a conjunction; (آخر) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (دعوى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif, and (هم) like the last; (أن) is the one lightened from the heavy (anna) [Note: This is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān; Ibn Hishām makes it redundant (zāʾida), because it is not preceded by something indicating certainty.], and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), necessarily omitted; (الحمد) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (للَّه) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الحمد; (ربّ) a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty, genitive; (العالمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «دعواهم فيها …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: Or a third khabar of (إنّ).].
The clause «(نسبّح) سبحانك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ دعواهم [Note: The clause lacks the link that binds it to the mubtadaʾ, but it coincides with the mubtadaʾ in meaning.].
The vocative clause «اللهمّ» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical and supplicatory.
The clause «تحيّتهم.. سلام» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «دعواهم …».
The clause «آخر دعواهم …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «دعواهم …».
The clause «الحمد للَّه …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the lightened أن.
The interpreted maṣdar from the lightened أن, its noun and its khabar is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (آخر).

* Morphology:
(دعوى): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb دعا يدعو; its pattern is فعلى with fatḥa on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(تحيّة): a regular maṣdar of the verb حيّا يحيّي. A tāʾ marbūṭa has been substituted for one of the three yāʾs; the origin of the maṣdar is تحيية. When two yāʾs came together and it was desired to merge them, the ḥāʾ was given kasra and the first yāʾ sukūn; so the pattern is تفعلة, and its origin is تفعيل. The annexation of التحيّة to the pronoun is either an annexation of the maṣdar to its agent, if they are the ones who greet the angels, or an annexation of the maṣdar to its object, if it is Allah who greets them.

* Benefits:
In this verse there occurs His saying, the Exalted, سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ. We are concerned here with the word (سبحانك): we parse it as a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. There are maṣdars that run in this same way and are parsed in the same way; since this is one of the important matters and is hidden from many, we have seen fit, to complete the benefit, to mention them. There are aurally transmitted maṣdars whose use has become widespread and which have no verbs [expressed], but the contextual indicators point to them, such as: (سمعا وطاعة، عجبا، حمدا وشكرا لا كفرا، معاذ اللَّه). It is useful to present here a selection of these aurally transmitted maṣdars, because of how often they are on people's tongues:
1- Among them are those used only in annexation, such as: سبحان اللَّه، معاذ اللَّه.
Among them the following maṣdars have come in the dual: (لبيك، لبيك وسعديك، وحنانيك، ودواليك، وحذاريك). By that the speaker intends multiplication, as if saying: "a response to You after a response", "compassion after compassion".
2- Among them are those used without annexation, like the first examples, and like (حجرا محجورا), meaning "a barring that is barred (منعا ممنوعا)".
3- In detailing something summarised or stating an outcome, as in فَشُدُّوا الْوَثاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِداءً.
4- Maṣdars have come that have no verbs, such as (ويل، ويب) in imprecation against a person, and (ويح، ويس) in supplication for him, and (بله). They suppose for them a governing word from their meaning without pronouncing it. When these maṣdars are annexed, the accusative is obligatory; when they are not annexed, both the accusative and starting the sentence with them (as mubtadaʾ) are permitted. We say: (ويل للظالم) and (ويلا للظالم); but in the like of (ويل الظالم) there is nothing but the accusative, because it has been annexed.
[Translator's note: The word "[expressed]" is added for clarity. In the last example the source prints «ويل الظالم» without a case vowel while saying only the accusative is possible.]

safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (يعجّل) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يعجّل); (الشرّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (استعجالهم) accusative by removal of the preposition [Note: Or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), but with two things supposed: the maṣdar of the verb عجّل, and the adjective which is the muḍāf, i.e. "Allah hastens a hastening like their seeking to hasten good (يعجّل اللَّه تعجيلا مثل استعجالهم بالخير)".], i.e. "like their seeking to hasten (كاستعجالهم)", and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (بالخير) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of the maṣdar استعجال, i.e. "their seeking to hasten matters with good" [Note: It may be attached to the maṣdar استعجال.], (اللام) occurring in the apodosis (jawāb) of لو; (قضي) a past verb, passive; (إلى) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive — attached to (قضي); (أجل) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) a conjunction; (نذر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "We (نحن)", for majesty; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (لا يرجون لقاءنا): its i'rab has already been given [Note: In verse (7) of this sūra.]; (في طغيان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعمهون), and (هم) like the last; (يعمهون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يعجّل اللَّه …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قضي إليهم أجلهم …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «نذر …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumptive clause containing a correction (istidrāk) of what preceded, i.e. "if Allah hastened evil for people He would destroy them, but We give them respite, so We leave…"; so there is an iltifāt (shift of person) in the speech.
The clause «لا يرجون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يعمهون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl [Note: The clause may be a second object if the verb (نذر) is supposed to be doubly transitive.].

* Morphology:
(استعجال): a regular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the six-letter verb استعجل; its pattern is استفعال.

* Rhetoric:
- Tankīt (pointed wording): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ الشَّرَّ اسْتِعْجالَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرِ». Its original form is «وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ الشَّرَّ» "as He hastens good for them (تعجيله لهم الخير)"; «اسْتِعْجالَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرِ» was put in the place of "His hastening good for them" to convey the swiftness of His answering them and granting their requests, so that their seeking to hasten good is as if it were itself a hastening for them. This is weighty speech that shows the precision of its Author, since an emphatic maṣdar is hardly ever placed alongside a verb other than its own in the Mighty Book without some such great benefit. The grammarians say about this: "The maṣdar was made to run on an implied verb indicated by the one mentioned," and add nothing to that. But when an astute person consults his natural talent and confers with his thought, he knows that it was paired with a verb not its own only for a benefit. In His saying, the Exalted, «وَاللَّهُ أَنْبَتَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ نَباتاً» it is to draw attention to the effectiveness of the divine power in what it decrees and the swiftness of carrying out its judgement, so that Allah the Exalted's causing them to grow is as if it were itself their growing; i.e. when the causing-to-grow exists, the growing necessarily exists, so that it is as if one of them were the very other, and so it was paired with it.

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (دعانا); (مسّ) a past verb; (الإنسان) a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الضرّ) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (دعا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (لجنب) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of دعا, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (أو) a conjunction; (قاعدا) conjoined to the first ḥāl, accusative, and likewise (قائما). (الفاء) a conjunction; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when (حين)", containing the meaning of condition, attached to (مرّ); (كشف) like مسّ, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (عن) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive — attached to (كشفنا); (ضرّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) like the last; (مرّ) like مسّ, and the fāʿil is "he"; (كأن) a particle of likening causing the accusative, lightened from the heavy (ka-anna), and its noun is omitted, i.e. "as if he (كأنّه)"; (لم) a particle of negation causing the jussive; (يدعنا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, and (نا) like the last; (إلى ضرّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدعنا), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "to the repelling of harm" or "the removal of harm"; (مسّ) like the first, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "it", i.e. the harm.
The clause «مسّ.. الضرّ..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «دعانا …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كشفنا …» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «مرّ …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of the condition (لمّا).
The clause «كأن لم يدعنا …» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of مرّ.
The clause «لم يدعنا …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of كأن.
The clause «مسّه» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ضرّ.
(الكاف) a preposition and particle of likening; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) governed by the coming زيّن; (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (زيّن) a past verb, passive; (للمسرفين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (زيّن), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (كانوا) an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and the wāw is the noun of kāna; (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (كانوا..) is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «زيّن للمسرفين …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كانوا….» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
[Translator's note: The source writes the interpreted maṣdar as «(كانوا..)»; meant is (ما كانوا..). It also prints «مخفّف من التثقيلة», a misprint for «من الثقيلة».]

* Rhetoric:
- Taqsīm (division), or ṣiḥḥat al-aqsām (soundness of the divisions): it consists in the speaker's exhausting all the divisions of the meaning he is engaged in, so that he leaves nothing of it out. His saying «دَعانا لِجَنْبِهِ أَوْ قاعِداً أَوْ قائِماً» exhausts all the postures in which a human being may be. Taqsīm has also come up in Āl ʿImrān.

* Benefits:
- The stirrings of souls and the conditions of people:
This noble verse depicts for us a human type among people that is not specific to a time or place, but recurs and continues across all times and places. It is a widespread type and forms the great majority — except those on whom your Lord has mercy, and how few they are. In this verse we are with man when harm touches him or a calamity befalls him: he calls on Allah in all his states, lying down, standing or sitting; but when Allah removes the harm from him, he forgets Allah and passes on as if nothing had happened yesterday! This is one of the aspects of the inimitability of the Noble Qur'an: it depicts the human soul in all its dimensions and all its states, and we see this depiction holding true of the human race in every time and place until the Hour is established. And no wonder, for Allah is the Creator of man and knows what he is, and nothing hidden in souls or horizons is hidden from Him.

safi-cedvel:87-88.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (أوحينا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), for majesty (taʿẓīm). (إلى موسى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوحينا), and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, as it is a diptote. (الواو) conjunction. (أخي) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to موسى, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أن) an explicative particle [Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and it together with the verb after it is an interpreted maṣdar in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), whose governor is أوحينا, i.e. "We revealed to them both the settling".], (تبّوأا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn..
and (الألف) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبّوأا), and (كما) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (بمصر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبوّأا) [Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (بيوتا) — a naʿt (adjective) placed before the noun it qualifies — or a ḥāl from the fāʿil of تبوّأا, and in that there is weakness according to the view of Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī.], and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, as it is a diptote. (بيوتا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) conjunction. (اجعلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is fāʿil. (بيوت) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قبلة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (أقيموا الصلاة) like اجعلوا بيوت. (الواو) conjunction. (بشّر) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you". (المؤمنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «أوحينا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تبوّأا ...» has no grammatical position; explicative.
The clause «اجعلوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the explicative clause.
The clause «أقيموا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the explicative clause.
The clause «بشرّ ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the explicative clause.
(الواو) conjunction. (قال موسى) its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (84) of this sūra.
(2, 3, 4) in verse (85) of this sūra.], (ربّنا) like the previous one «2», (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. (آتيت) a past verb and its fāʿil. (فرعون) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and it is barred from nunation because of being a proper name and foreign (al-ʿalamiyya wa-l-ʿujma). (الواو) conjunction. (ملأ) conjoined to فرعون, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (زينة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (أموالا) conjoined by the wāw to زينة, accusative. (في الحياة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آتيت), (الدنيا) naʿt of الحياة, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied on the alif. (ربّنا) like the previous one «3», (اللام) the lām of consequence (lām al-ʿāqiba). (يضلّوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is fāʿil. (عن سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يضلوا), and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi. (ربّنا) like the previous one «4», (اطمس) a precative (duʿāʾī) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you". (على أموال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اطمس), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (اشدد على قلوبهم) like اطمس على أموالهم. (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya) [Note: It may be a conjunction that conjoins the verb (لا يؤمنوا) to (يضلوا).. and what is between them is a parenthetical supplication.. And (لا) may be a precative particle of prohibition, the verb being jussive (majzūm) by the particle of prohibition.], (لا) negative. (يؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ, and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is fāʿil. (حتّى) a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. (يروا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتّى, and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is fāʿil. (العذاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الأليم) naʿt of العذاب, accusative. The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضلّوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (آتيت).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يؤمنوا) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding supplication, i.e. "let there be from You a hardening upon their hearts, and so a lack of faith from them".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يروا..) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (اشدد).
The clause «قال موسى ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أوحينا إلى موسى ...
The clause «the vocative and its response» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) «1».
The clause «إنّك آتيت ...» has no grammatical position; response to the vocative.
The clause «آتيت فرعون ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «the second vocative» has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
The clause «يضلّوا» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «ربّنا.. the third» has no grammatical position; resumptive within the scope of the speech «2».
The clause «اطمس ...» has no grammatical position; response to the third vocative.
The clause «اشدد ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause اطمس.
The clause «يؤمنوا ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the second implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يروا ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the third implied particle relative (أن).

safi-cedvel:89-89.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he", i.e. Allah. (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq). (أجيبت) a passive past verb. And (التاء) for the feminine. (دعوة) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (كما) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الفاء) conjunction, for linking the effect to the cause. (استقيما) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الألف) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) prohibitive, making jussive. (تتّبعانّ) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn, as it is one of the five verbs.. and (الألف) is fāʿil, and (النون) is the heavy nūn of emphasis [Note: The verb attributed to the alif of the dual, the wāw of the plural or the yāʾ of the feminine addressee, when the nūn of emphasis enters it, is declinable (muʿrab), and the nūn is doubled with kasra when with the alif of the dual. Also, (لا) may be negative, the verb then being nominative by the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of like letters.. and the clause is resumptive.], (سبيل) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (لا) negative. (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil.
The clause «قال ...» has no position [Translator's note: the source has «لا محلّ» without «لها»]; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أجيبت دعوتكما» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «استقيما» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "take heed, and so stand firm"...
The clause «لا تتّبعانّ ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause استقيما.
The clause «لا يعلمون» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).

* Morphology:
(دعوة), an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb دعا يدعو, in the sense of الدعاء (supplication); its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
Variation in address (al-tanwīʿ fī al-khiṭāb): the Glorified One varied in addressing them: first He used the dual, then the plural, then finally the singular. The secret in that is that Mūsā and Hārūn were addressed to settle houses for their people and to choose them for worship; then the address was made general, to them both and to their people, to take places of prostration for praying in them, because that is obligatory on the generality; then finally Mūsā was singled out for the glad tidings, which are the loftiest aim, out of exaltation of them and of the one who gives them.

* Benefits:
- Emphasizing the verb with the nūn:
In this verse there occurs His saying, Exalted is He, وَلا تَتَّبِعانِّ سَبِيلَ الَّذِينَ لا يَعْلَمُونَ. The verb (وَلا تَتَّبِعانِّ) has had the heavy nūn of emphasis enter upon its end. This nūn enters the imperfect and the imperative, and does not enter the past. There is a precise rule in emphasizing the verb, which we will explain in what follows:
1- If the imperfect is attributed to an overt noun or to the pronoun of the singular, what precedes the nūn takes fatḥa, whether the verb is sound or defective, so we say: لينصرنّ علي and ليدعونّ, and ليرمينّ, and ليسعينّ.
2- If it is attributed to the alif of the dual, the nūn of emphasis takes kasra after the alif, so we say:
لينصرنّ, and ليدعوانّ, and ليرميانّ, and ليسعيانّ. [Translator's note: the first example is printed «لينصرنّ»; the dual form would be «لينصرانّ».]
3- If it is attributed to the wāw of the plural, what precedes the nūn takes ḍamma, and the last letter of the defective verb is dropped absolutely, and the wāw of the plural is also dropped, except in the verb weak with alif, where it remains, vowelled with a vowel congruent with it, so we say:
لينصرنّ, and ليدعنّ, and ليرمنّ, and ليسعونّ.
4- If it is attributed to the yāʾ of the feminine addressee, what precedes the nūn takes kasra, and the last letter of the defective verb is dropped absolutely, and the yāʾ of the feminine addressee is also dropped, except in the verb weak with alif, where it remains with a vowel congruent with it, so you say: لتنصرنّ, and لتدعنّ, and لترمنّ, and لتسعينّ.
5- If it is attributed to the nūn of the feminine plural, an alif is added between the two nūns and the nūn of emphasis takes kasra, so you say: لينصرنانّ, ليدعونانّ, ليرمينانّ, ليسعينانّ. And the imperative is like the imperfect in that, so you say: انصرنّ, ادعونّ, ارمينّ, اسعينّ, and so on.

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative; (ثمّ) conjunction; (إذا) adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنتم); (ما) redundant (zāʾida); (وقع) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو», i.e. the punishment; (آمنتم) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, with its fāʿil; (الباء) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (آمنتم), and the pronoun refers to Allah; (الهمزة) for the interrogative; (الآن) adverb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being «تؤمنون» (you believe); (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (قد) particle of verification (taḥqīq); (كنتم) defective past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (به) like the first one, attached to (تستعجلون) by its being made to include the meaning of «تكذبون» (you deny); (تستعجلون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «the condition, its verb and its apodosis ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أرأيتم» [Note: in the previous verse (50).].
The clause «وقع ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «آمنتم به ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «الآن (تؤمنون) ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كنتم به تستعجلون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of «تؤمنون».
The clause «تستعجلون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».

* Morphology:
(الآن): the interrogative hamza was merged with the connective hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) of the definite article (ال) into a single alif with a madda over it, and such is the case with every connective hamza of the definite article (ال) when it is preceded by a hamza. It is said that this merging is obligatory, and it is said that it is permissible, by dropping the connective hamza entirely and keeping the interrogative hamza. Six places of this kind occur in the Qur'an in which the two alifs were merged.. two in al-Anʿām, namely (الذكرين) [Note: in verses (143) and (144).] twice, and three in this sūra, namely (الآن) here [Note: and in verse (91).], and the word (الله) [Note: in verse (60) of this sūra.], and the word (الله) in Sūrat al-Naml [Note: in verse (59).].

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ) conjunction; (قيل) past verb, passive (mabnī lil-majhūl); (اللام) preposition; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قيل); (ظلموا) past verb with its fāʿil (agent); (ذوقوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عذاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الخلد) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (هل) interrogative particle in the sense of negation; (تجزون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (الباء) preposition of causation; (ما) maṣdar-forming particle; (كنتم) like the preceding one «1»; (تكسبون) like «تستعجلون» «2». [Translator's note: «1» and «2» are cross-reference markers left in the source; they refer to the parsing of (كنتم) and (تستعجلون) in the previous verse (51).]
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the verb «تجزون» [Note: it is permissible for (ما) to be a relative noun, the clause being its ṣila (relative clause), with the referring pronoun omitted.].
The clause «قيل ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause «الآن (تؤمنون)» [Note: in the previous verse (51).. or it is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to that same clause if it is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying.].
The clause «ظلموا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ذوقوا ...» is in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «تجزون ...» has no grammatical position, having the status of a causal explanation (taʿlīl).
The clause «كنتم تكسبون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تكسبون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».

* Rhetoric:
Implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «ذُوقُوا عَذابَ الْخُلْدِ», i.e. the painful one, perpetually.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يستنبئون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الهمزة) for the interrogative; (حقّ) fronted khabar (predicate), nominative [Note: or a mubtadaʾ (subject) relying on an interrogative, with (هو) as the fāʿil of the maṣdar, standing in place of the khabar.]; (هو) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; (إي) particle of answer; (الواو) the wāw of oath; (ربّ) genitive (majrūr) by the wāw, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on its end, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb «أقسم» (I swear), and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إنّ) particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (اللام) the lām of oath [Note: it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) in contexts other than an oath.]; (حقّ) khabar of inna, nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما) negative, functioning like laysa; (أنتم) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as the noun of «ما»; (الباء) redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (معجزين) genitive in form, accusative in position, as the khabar of «ما», the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «يستنبئونك ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «حقّ هو» is in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of the verb «يستنبئون», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «(أقسم) بربّي ..» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
